 $('quantCapitalModel').value=state.capitalModel;$('quantAlloc').disabled=state.capitalModel==='historical';$('quantCapitalInfo').textContent=state.capitalModel==='historical'?'Archiv: monatlich bis 20 % der Reserve, mindestens 100 € solange vorhanden · freies Budget deaktiviert':'Freier Depotanteil, gleichmäßig auf alle Bots verteilt';$('quantAlloc').value=String(Math.round(state.allocation*100));$('wfAlloc').value=String(Math.round(state.allocation*100));$('quantTake').value=quantTakeKey(state);$('quantTakeCustom').hidden=quantTakeKey(state)!=='custom';for(const [id,key] of [['quantTakeFirst','first'],['quantTakeFirstPct','firstPct'],['quantTakeStep','step'],['quantTakeStepPct','stepPct']])$(id).value=quantTakeCustom(state)[key];$('quantDepotTrail').value=String(state.depotTrail);$('quantDepotAction').value=state.depotAction;$('quantDepotLock').value=String(state.depotLock);$('quantDepotPause').value=state.depotPause;$('quantVaultProfits').checked=state.vaultProfits;$('quantRiskTiny').textContent=state.depotTrail?'-'+state.depotTrail+'%'+(state.depotLock?' · Gewinn +'+state.depotLock+'%':''):(state.depotLock?'Gewinn +'+state.depotLock+'%':'Aus')+(state.vaultProfits?' · Tresor':'');$('quantExecution').value=state.execution;quantSetExecLabel();$('correlationLimit').value=state.corrLimit===null?'off':String(state.corrLimit);$('corrFallback').checked=state.corrFallback;
}
function quantMoneyRulesChanged(){quantOosInvalidate();quantSweepInvalidate();state.portKey='';state.port=null;setStatus();queueBotCurves();}
function changePool(){quantBoxSweepInvalidate();quantOosInvalidate();if(!quantSweepApplying)quantSweepInvalidate();state.portKey='';state.filtered=eligible();state.grid=buildHeatmap();state.port=null;setStatus();quantSyncRenkoDeck();renderChart();queueBotCurves();}
function applyPreset(n){
 if(n==='tp'){state.x='tp';state.y='s';state.family='tp';state.familyEnabled={none:false,tp:true,ttp:false,both:false};state.box='all';state.mode='all4158';}
 else if(n==='ttp'){state.x='act';state.y='s';state.family='ttp';state.familyEnabled={none:false,tp:false,ttp:true,both:false};state.box='all';state.mode='all4158';}
 else if(n==='tpttp'){state.x='tp';state.y='s';state.family='both';state.familyEnabled={none:false,tp:false,ttp:false,both:true};state.box='all';state.mode='all4158';}
 else if(n==='original'){state.x='s';state.y='b';state.family='none';state.familyEnabled={none:true,tp:false,ttp:false,both:false};state.box='all';state.priceMode='renko_usd';state.mode='original462';}
 else if(n==='all'){state.x='s';state.y='b';state.family='all';state.familyEnabled={none:true,tp:true,ttp:true,both:true};state.box='all';state.mode='all4158';state.surfaceMode='overlay';$('surfaceMode').value='overlay';}
 else if(n==='top100'){state.x='s';state.y='b';state.family='all';state.familyEnabled={none:true,tp:true,ttp:true,both:true};state.box='all';state.mode='top100';}
 syncModeControls();setControls();changePool();
}
function serialize(){return {version:13,priceMode:state.priceMode,date:DATES[state.day],year:state.dataset,smooth:state.smooth,surfaceMode:state.surfaceMode,layers:state.layers,layerOpacity:state.layerOpacity,axisX:state.x,axisY:state.y,family:state.family,box:state.box,
 mode:state.mode,familyEnabled:state.familyEnabled,horizon:state.horizon,rank:state.rank,stop:state.guard,topCount:state.topCount,stopScope:state.stopScope,allocation:state.allocation,capitalModel:state.capitalModel,takePlan:state.takePlan,takeCustom:{...state.takeCustom},depotTrail:state.depotTrail,depotAction:state.depotAction,depotLock:state.depotLock,depotPause:state.depotPause,vaultProfits:state.vaultProfits,corrLimit:state.corrLimit,corrFallback:state.corrFallback,sweepObjective:quantSweepObjective(),selected:[...state.manual].map(i=>META[i].id)};}
function downloadJSON(){const b=new Blob([JSON.stringify(serialize(),null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),u=URL.createObjectURL(b),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download='quant_genome_0_33_preset.json';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(u);}
function supportsWebGL(){try{const c=document.createElement('canvas');return !!(c.getContext('webgl2')||c.getContext('webgl')||c.getContext('experimental-webgl'));}catch(e){return false;}}

function modeLabel(){return state.priceMode==='candle'?'5-Minuten-Candles (kein Renko)':state.priceMode==='renko_pct'?'Renko · Prozent vom Kurs':'Renko · feste USD-Box';}
function syncModeControls(){
 $('useCandles').checked=state.priceMode==='candle';$('usePercent').checked=state.priceMode==='renko_pct';
 $('modeTag').textContent=modeLabel();
 $('modeExplanation').textContent=state.priceMode==='candle'?'Normaler 5m-OHLC-Kerzen-IMBA: S×10 Candles, keine Boxgröße.':'Alle tatsächlich berechneten Renko-Boxen verfügbar. Einzeln per Regler oder alle zusammen.';
 $('useAllBoxes').disabled=state.priceMode==='candle';
 if(state.priceMode==='candle')state.box='all';
 $('useAllBoxes').checked=state.box==='all';
 $('boxStep').disabled=state.priceMode==='candle'||state.box==='all';
 $('boxStepLabel').textContent=state.priceMode==='candle'?'kein Renko':(Number($('boxStep').value)/10).toFixed(1)+(state.priceMode==='renko_pct'?' %':' USD');
 const boxes=quantModeBoxes(state.priceMode);
 if(state.box!=='all'){$('boxStep').value=String(Math.round(Number(state.box)*10));$('boxStepLabel').textContent=Number(state.box).toFixed(2)+(state.priceMode==='renko_pct'?' %':' USD');}
 const prev=state.box;
 populateSelector('boxFilter',[['all','Alle gerechneten Werte'],...boxes.map(b=>[b.toFixed(2),b.toFixed(2)+(state.priceMode==='renko_pct'?' %':' USD')])], prev);
 if($('boxFilter').value!==prev){state.box='all';$('boxFilter').value='all';$('useAllBoxes').checked=true;}
 if(state.x==='b'&&state.priceMode==='candle'){state.x='s';state.y='exit';$('axisX').value=state.x;$('axisY').value=state.y;}
 quantSyncRenkoDeck();
}
function switchPriceMode(kind){
 if(!['candle','renko_pct','renko_usd'].includes(kind))return;
 const prior=state.box;
 state.priceMode=kind;
 const valid=quantModeBoxes(kind);
 state.box=kind==='candle'||prior==='all'?'all':(valid.length?valid.reduce((best,b)=>Math.abs(b-Number(prior))<Math.abs(best-Number(prior))?b:best,valid[0]).toFixed(2):'all');
 if(kind==='candle' && (state.x==='b'||state.y==='b')){state.x='s';state.y='exit';}
 if(kind!=='candle' && state.x==='s'&&state.y==='exit'){state.x='s';state.y='b';}
 syncModeControls();setControls();changePool();
}


// QUANT 0.35: chart-local Renko/Candle controls, using the already backtested, distinct signal histories.
let quantBoxSweepGeneration=0, quantBoxSweepBusy=false;
function quantModeBoxes(mode=state.priceMode){
 if(mode==='candle')return [];
 return [...new Set(META.filter(m=>m.priceMode===mode).map(m=>m.b))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
}
function quantSyncRenkoDeck(){
 const deck=$('quantRenkoDeck');if(!deck)return;
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-q35-mode]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.q35Mode===state.priceMode)));
 const boxes=quantModeBoxes();const boxSelect=$('q35BoxSize'),prior=state.box;
 boxSelect.innerHTML='<option value="all">Alle Boxen</option>'+boxes.map(v=>`<option value="${v.toFixed(2)}">${v.toFixed(2)} ${state.priceMode==='renko_pct'?'%':'USD'}</option>`).join('');
 boxSelect.disabled=state.priceMode==='candle';boxSelect.value=prior==='all'?'all':Number(prior).toFixed(2);
 if(boxSelect.selectedIndex<0)boxSelect.value='all';
 $('q35ShowGrid').disabled=state.priceMode==='candle';$('q35SweepToggle').disabled=state.priceMode==='candle';
 $('q35ShowGrid').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(state.box==='all'));
 const size=state.box==='all'?boxes.length+' getestete Boxreihen':(Number(state.box).toFixed(2)+(state.priceMode==='renko_pct'?' %':' USD'));
 const transfer=state.mode==='original462'&&state.priceMode!=='renko_usd'?' · Original-Gene in diesem Modus neu getestete Varianten':
 ['top100','balanced100','manual'].includes(state.mode)&&state.priceMode!=='renko_usd'?' · Gen-Übertrag aus USD-Pool (nicht identische Selektion)':'';
 $('q35ModeInfo').textContent=(state.priceMode==='candle'?'5m-Candle-IMBA · keine Boxgröße':state.priceMode==='renko_pct'?'Prozentuale Boxgröße relativ zum Kurs · '+size:'Feste absolute Boxgröße · '+size)+transfer+
  (state.dataset==='2022'&&state.priceMode!=='renko_usd'?' · Für 2022 liegen hier keine gültigen Backtests vor.':'');
 $('q35Population').textContent=(state.filtered?.length||0).toLocaleString('de-DE')+' Backtests · '+(state.priceMode==='renko_pct'?'%-Renko':state.priceMode==='candle'?'5m-Candles':'USD-Renko');
}
function quantBoxSweepClose(){quantBoxSweepGeneration++;quantBoxSweepBusy=false;$('q35SweepPanel').hidden=true;$('q35SweepRun').disabled=false;}
function quantBoxSweepInvalidate(){quantBoxSweepGeneration++;quantBoxSweepBusy=false;if($('q35SweepRun'))$('q35SweepRun').disabled=false;if($('q35SweepTable'))$('q35SweepTable').textContent='';if($('q35SweepStatus'))$('q35SweepStatus').textContent='Parameter geändert · erneut berechnen.';}
async function quantBoxSweepRun(){
 if(quantBoxSweepBusy||state.priceMode==='candle')return;
 const token=++quantBoxSweepGeneration;quantBoxSweepBusy=true;$('q35SweepRun').disabled=true;
 const status=$('q35SweepStatus'),table=$('q35SweepTable');table.textContent='';
 const mode=state.priceMode,year=state.dataset,window=$('q35SweepWindow').value;
 const obj=$('q35SweepObjective').value,boxes=quantModeBoxes(mode),bounds=quantSweepBounds(window,state.day);
 const savedBox=state.box;state.box='all';let base;try{base=eligible();}finally{state.box=savedBox;}
 const results=[];
 try{
  if(!base.length){status.textContent='Keine gültigen Backtests für diese Auswahl.';return;}
  for(let k=0;k<boxes.length;k++){
   if(token!==quantBoxSweepGeneration||state.priceMode!==mode||state.dataset!==year)return;
   const b=boxes[k],pool=base.filter(i=>Math.abs(META[i].b-b)<1e-8);
   if(pool.length){
    const equity=simulatePortfolio({pool,endDay:bounds.end});
    const r=quantSweepEvaluate(equity,bounds);
    results.push({...r,box:b,n:pool.length});
   }
   status.textContent=`Berechne Boxreihen ${k+1} / ${boxes.length} · ${bounds.startDate} bis ${bounds.endDate}`;
   await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,0));
  }
  if(token!==quantBoxSweepGeneration)return;
  results.sort((a,b)=>quantSweepCompare(a,b,obj));
  status.textContent=`${results.length} Boxreihen · ${bounds.startDate} bis ${bounds.endDate} · ${obj==='drawdown'?'minimaler Drawdown':obj==='profit'?'maximaler Gewinn':'maximale Rendite'} · retrospektiv`;
  const unit=mode==='renko_pct'?'%':'USD';
  table.innerHTML='<table><thead><tr><th>Box</th><th>Strategien</th><th>Rendite</th><th>Gewinn</th><th>Max. DD</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
   results.map(r=>`<tr><td>${r.box.toFixed(2)} ${unit}</td><td>${r.n}</td><td class="${r.windowPct>=0?'q35-good':'q35-bad'}">${r.windowPct===null?'–':pct(r.windowPct)}</td><td>${euro(r.windowProfit)}</td><td>−${number(r.maxDD,1)} %</td><td><button type="button" data-q35-apply-box="${r.box.toFixed(2)}">Anzeigen</button></td></tr>`).join('')+'</tbody></table>';
 }catch(err){status.textContent='Box-Sweep fehlgeschlagen: '+err.message;console.error(err);}
 finally{if(token===quantBoxSweepGeneration){quantBoxSweepBusy=false;$('q35SweepRun').disabled=false;}}
}
function quantBindRenkoDeck(){
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-q35-mode]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{quantBoxSweepInvalidate();switchPriceMode(b.dataset.q35Mode);}));
 $('q35BoxSize').addEventListener('change',e=>{quantBoxSweepInvalidate();state.box=e.target.value;syncModeControls();changePool();});
 $('q35ShowGrid').addEventListener('click',()=>{quantBoxSweepInvalidate();state.box='all';syncModeControls();changePool();});
 $('q35SweepToggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{const panel=$('q35SweepPanel');panel.hidden=!panel.hidden;if(!panel.hidden){$('q35SweepObjective').value=quantSweepObjective();$('q35SweepWindow').value=$('quantSweepWindow')?.value||'14';}});
 $('q35SweepObjective').addEventListener('change',e=>{const other=$('quantSweepObjective');if(other){other.value=e.target.value;other.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}});
 $('q35SweepWindow').addEventListener('change',e=>{const other=$('quantSweepWindow');if(other){other.value=e.target.value;other.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}});
 $('q35SweepClose').addEventListener('click',quantBoxSweepClose);
 $('q35SweepRun').addEventListener('click',quantBoxSweepRun);
 $('q35SweepTable').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-q35-apply-box]');if(!b)return;quantBoxSweepInvalidate();state.box=b.dataset.q35ApplyBox;syncModeControls();changePool();});
}

 $('pause').onclick=stop;
 function play(dir){
  if(wf)return;
  stop();state.dir=dir;
  // requestAnimationFrame coalesces updates; never queue up expensive WebGL plots.
  let elapsed=0,last=0;
  function tick(ts){
   if(state.playing===null)return;
   if(!last)last=ts;
   elapsed+=Math.max(0,ts-last);last=ts;
   if(elapsed>=state.playMs){
    elapsed%=state.playMs;
    const nx=state.day+dir;
    if(nx<0||nx>=DAYS){stop();return;}
    setDay(nx);
   }
   state.playing=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  state.playing=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 }

   document.querySelectorAll('[data-layer]').forEach(el=>el.checked=!!state.layers[el.dataset.layer]);
   state.x=AXES[x.axisX]?x.axisX:'tp';state.y=AXES[x.axisY]?x.axisY:'s';
   state.family=['all','none','tp','ttp','both','custom'].includes(x.family)?x.family:'all';
    state.familyEnabled=x.familyEnabled?Object.assign({none:false,tp:false,ttp:false,both:false},x.familyEnabled):Object.fromEntries(['none','tp','ttp','both'].map(f=>[f,state.family==='all'||state.family===f]));
    state.family=familySelectionMode();
   state.priceMode=['candle','renko_pct','renko_usd'].includes(x.priceMode)?x.priceMode:'renko_usd';
   state.box=x.box||'all';state.mode=x.mode||'all4158';state.horizon=x.horizon??30;
   state.rank=x.rank??14;state.guard=x.stop??30;state.topCount=[4,5,6].includes(Number(x.topCount))?Number(x.topCount):6;state.stopScope=['individual','global'].includes(x.stopScope)?x.stopScope:'individual';state.allocation=Math.max(.01,Math.min(1,Number(x.allocation??state.allocation)||1));state.capitalModel=x.capitalModel==='historical'?'historical':'modern';state.takePlan=QUANT_TAKE_LABELS[x.takePlan]?x.takePlan:state.takePlan;state.takeCustom=quantTakeCustom({takeCustom:x.takeCustom||state.takeCustom});state.takeProfit=state.takePlan.startsWith('legacy')?Number(state.takePlan.slice(6)):0;state.corrLimit=(x.corrLimit===null||x.corrLimit===undefined)?null:Number(x.corrLimit);state.corrFallback=!!x.corrFallback;
   state.depotTrail=[0,10,15,20,25,30,40].includes(Number(x.depotTrail))?Number(x.depotTrail):0;state.depotAction=x.depotAction==='half'?'half':'flat';state.depotLock=[0,10,20,30,50,100].includes(Number(x.depotLock))?Number(x.depotLock):0;state.depotPause=['cycle','14','30','year'].includes(x.depotPause)?x.depotPause:'cycle';state.vaultProfits=Boolean(x.vaultProfits);
    if(QUANT_SWEEP_OBJECTIVES[x.sweepObjective])$('quantSweepObjective').value=x.sweepObjective;
    syncModeControls();setControls();$('horizon').value=state.horizon;$('slider').value=state.day;updateManual();changePool();
  }catch(err){alert('Preset konnte nicht geladen werden: '+err.message);}
 };
 $('downloadPool').onclick=()=>{const lines=['strategy_id,price_mode,sensitivity,renko_box_value,exit_program,tp_pct,ttp_activation_pct,ttp_trail_pct,return_2026_ytd_pct,return_2022_pct'];
  for(const i of state.filtered){const m=META[i];lines.push([m.id,m.priceMode,m.s,m.b,m.exitKey,m.tpValue,m.act,m.trail,rPct(i,DAYS-1,0)].join(','));}
  const b=new Blob([lines.join('\n')],{type:'text/csv'}),u=URL.createObjectURL(b),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download='quant_genome_v9_echte_kandidaten.csv';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(u);
 };
 state.points='top6';state.horizon=14;$('horizon').value='14';$('wfPeriod').value='14';state.filtered=eligible();state.grid=buildHeatmap();
 setControls();setStatus();renderChart();updateManual();
}

// 2026 favorite settings from screenshots and evidence charts, NOT live trading changes.
let researchMode='mix';
let reportIsOpen=false;
function saved2026Info(key){
 const p=SCREENSHOT_PRESETS[key];const info=$('snapshotNote');
 if(!p){info.textContent='Bitte ein Preset wählen.';return;}
 const original=p.screenshot?`Gesichert aus ${p.screenshot}`:'Vergleichsvariante – nicht in den drei Screenshots enthalten';
 info.innerHTML=`<strong>${p.label}</strong><br>${original}. Historischer Archivwert nach altem Modell: <b>${euro(p.wealth_at_1000)}</b>. Neues Budgetmodell nicht direkt vergleichbar.`;
}
async function loadSaved2026(key){
 const p=SCREENSHOT_PRESETS[key];if(!p)return;
 if(state.playing!==null){cancelAnimationFrame(state.playing);state.playing=null;}
 if(state.dataset!=='2026')await loadYear('2026');
 state.mode=p.pool;state.rank=p.rank;state.guard=p.guard;state.topCount=6;state.stopScope='individual';state.corrLimit=null;state.corrFallback=false;
 state.family='all';state.familyEnabled={none:true,tp:true,ttp:true,both:true};
 state.priceMode='renko_usd';state.box='all';state.x='s';state.y='b';state.day=DAYS-1;
 state.chart=supportsWebGL()?'3d':'2d';state.points='top6';state.horizon=30;
 $('chartType').value=state.chart;$('horizon').value=30;$('pointsMode').value='top6';
 $('slider').value=state.day;
 syncModeControls();setControls();changePool();saved2026Info(key);
 $('activeSnapshot').textContent=`Aktiv: ${p.label}`;
}
function chartTheme(title,extra={}){return {...{
 title:{text:title,font:{size:16,color:'#dcecf5'},x:0.03},paper_bgcolor:'#0c2336',plot_bgcolor:'#102b40',
 font:{family:'system-ui, Arial',color:'#c9deed',size:12},margin:{t:55,l:65,r:35,b:55},
 xaxis:{gridcolor:'#2b4758',zerolinecolor:'#335668',title:''},
 yaxis:{gridcolor:'#2b4758',zerolinecolor:'#335668',title:'Depotwert (€)',tickformat:',.0f'},
 legend:{orientation:'h',x:0,y:1.12,font:{size:10}},hovermode:'x unified',uirevision:'quant-v13-'+researchMode
 },...extra};}
const chartOpts={responsive:true,displaylogo:false,modeBarButtonsToRemove:['lasso2d','select2d']};
function renderResearchCharts(){
 if(!reportIsOpen)return;
 const b=EVIDENCE_CHARTS;
 const names={original:'Original 462 · 333,33 €',raw:'Top100 Raw · 333,33 €',balanced:'Balanced B · 333,34 €',mixed:'Drei-Büschel-Mix',previous:'Bisheriger Mix (Balanced −30 %)'};
 const color={original:'#61bdd8',raw:'#f3ad71',balanced:'#c3a1f4',mixed:'#e7d27a',previous:'#8493a7'};
 const el=$('researchChart');
 const note=$('researchChartNote');
 if(researchMode==='mix'){
  const traces=['original','raw','balanced','mixed','previous'].map(k=>({type:'scatter',mode:'lines',x:b.mix.dates,y:b.mix[k],name:names[k],
   line:{color:color[k],width:k==='mixed'?3:k==='previous'?1.5:1.9,dash:k==='previous'?'dot':'solid'}}));
  Plotly.react(el,traces,chartTheme('2026 · Ein Depot, drei unabhängige Büschel'),chartOpts);
  note.textContent='Start: 333,33 € + 333,33 € + 333,34 € = 1.000 €. Der Mix ist die Summe der drei getrennt verwalteten Kapitalkurven. Die ausgepunktete Variante verwendet Balanced −30 % statt −25 %.';
 }else if(researchMode==='sharpe'){
  const stats=b.stats;const name=stats.map(s=>s.portfolio),cols=['#61bdd8','#f3ad71','#c3a1f4','#e7d27a'];
  const traces=[{type:'bar',name:'Sharpe (365d)',x:name,y:stats.map(v=>v.sharpe_365d),marker:{color:cols},text:stats.map(v=>v.sharpe_365d.toFixed(2)),textposition:'outside',hovertemplate:'%{x}: Sharpe %{y:.3f}<extra></extra>'}];
  Plotly.react(el,traces,chartTheme('2026 · Sharpe Ratio, einheitlich 1.000 € Startkapital',{
    margin:{t:55,l:60,r:25,b:115},xaxis:{tickangle:-18,gridcolor:'#2b4758'},yaxis:{title:'Sharpe · 365 Tage',gridcolor:'#2b4758'},showlegend:false}),chartOpts);
  note.innerHTML='<b>Endwerte / maximaler Drawdown:</b> '+stats.map(s=>`${s.portfolio}: ${euro(s.end_eur)} / ${s.max_drawdown_pct.toFixed(1)} %`).join(' · ')+'<br>Vergleich basiert auf täglichen Depotwertänderungen (risikofrei = 0, 365 Tage annualisiert).';
 }else{
  const family=b.annual;
  const tr=[['carry_2022','2022er Familie behalten','#f3ad71'],['annual_rotate','Jährlich neue Top 100','#70d6ab'],['accumulate_past','Frühere Jahrgänge sammeln','#c3a1f4']].map(([key,name,col])=>({
    type:'scatter',mode:'lines',x:family[key].dates,y:family[key].wealth,name,line:{color:col,width:2}}));
  Plotly.react(el,tr,chartTheme('2023–2026 · Top-100-Jahresfamilien: durchgehendes Kapital',{
    yaxis:{title:'Depotwert (€), logarithmisch',type:'log',gridcolor:'#2b4758',range:[-2,4.5]},
    legend:{orientation:'h',x:0,y:1.14,font:{size:10}}}),chartOpts);
  note.textContent='Separate Forschungsreihe: 1.000 € Anfang 2023, danach ohne Neustart, 14-Tage-Ranking, 30-%-Einzelstopps. Logarithmische Euro-Skala. Jahrgänge werden ausschließlich aus abgeschlossenen Vorjahren ausgewählt.';
 }
}
function bindSavedEvidence(){
 const selector=$('snapshotPreset');
 selector.onchange=e=>saved2026Info(e.target.value);
 $('applySnapshot').onclick=()=>loadSaved2026(selector.value);
 saved2026Info(selector.value);
 $('researchDetails').addEventListener('toggle',()=>{
  reportIsOpen=$('researchDetails').open;
  if(reportIsOpen)requestAnimationFrame(renderResearchCharts);
 });
 $('chartsJump').onclick=()=>{
  const panel=$('researchDetails');panel.open=true;panel.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
  reportIsOpen=true;requestAnimationFrame(renderResearchCharts);
 };
 for(const btn of document.querySelectorAll('[data-research-mode]')){
  btn.onclick=()=>{
   researchMode=btn.dataset.researchMode;
   document.querySelectorAll('[data-research-mode]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===btn));
   renderResearchCharts();
  };
 }
}


// v14: visual-only per-strategy curves. Does not change selection, orders or portfolio engine.
const curvePinned=new Set();
let curveRequest=0;
function queueBotCurves(){if(curveRequest)return;curveRequest=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{curveRequest=0;renderBotCurves();});}
function toggleLinkedPin(id){
 if(!Number.isInteger(id)||!META[id])return;
 if(curvePinned.has(id))curvePinned.delete(id);else curvePinned.add(id);
 inspect(id);queueBotCurves();renderCurvePins();
 // Updating the selected markers must not rebuild thousands of surfaces or traces.
 const el=$('chart');
 if(el&&el.data&&Number.isInteger(el._quantPinTrace)){
  const ids=[...curvePinned].filter(i=>state.filtered.includes(i));
  const update={x:[ids.map(i=>realAxisValue(i,state.x))],y:[ids.map(i=>realAxisValue(i,state.y))],
    customdata:[ids],hovertext:[ids.map(i=>META[i].id+' · MARKIERT')]};
  if(state.chart==='3d')update.z=[ids.map(i=>value(i)+1.8)];
  Plotly.restyle(el,update,[el._quantPinTrace]).catch(console.error);
 }else renderChart();
}
function quantRedrawPinnedOverlay(){
 const el=$('chart'),ids=[...curvePinned].filter(i=>state.filtered.includes(i));
 if(el?.data&&Number.isInteger(el._quantPinTrace)&&el._quantPinTrace>=0){
  const update={x:[ids.map(i=>realAxisValue(i,state.x))],y:[ids.map(i=>realAxisValue(i,state.y))],
   customdata:[ids],hovertext:[ids.map(i=>META[i].id+' · MARKIERT')]};
  if(state.chart==='3d')update.z=[ids.map(i=>value(i)+1.8)];
  Plotly.restyle(el,update,[el._quantPinTrace]).catch(console.error);
 }else if(!state.rendering)renderChart();
 renderCurvePins();
}
function renderCurvePins(){
 const target=$('curveSelection');if(!target)return;
 target.innerHTML=[...curvePinned].map(i=>`<button type="button" data-curve-pin="${i}" title="Klicken zum Entfernen">✕ ${META[i].id.replaceAll('&','&amp;').replaceAll('<','&lt;')}</button>`).join('');
 target.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{toggleLinkedPin(+b.dataset.curvePin);});
}
function renderBotCurves(){
 const el=$('botCurves');if(!el||!PREFIX||!DATES||!state.filtered)return;
 if(wf&&wf.next===0){Plotly.react(el,[],{paper_bgcolor:'#0c2032',plot_bgcolor:'#0c2032',font:{color:'#c6d9e8'},annotations:[{text:'Noch keine Handelstage freigegeben · Ranking nur Vorjahres-Warm-up',xref:'paper',yref:'paper',x:.5,y:.5,showarrow:false}]},{responsive:true});$('curveSummary').textContent='Vor dem ersten Abschnitt: keine künftigen Einzelkurven sichtbar.';return;}
 const end=Math.min(state.day,wf?wf.next-1:state.day),start=state.horizon>0?Math.max(0,end-state.horizon+1):0;
 const dates=[DATES[start]+'T00:00:00',...DATES.slice(start,end+1).map(d=>d+'T23:59:00')];
 const ids=state.filtered,activeList=wf?(wf.decisions.at(-1)?.traded||[]).map(id=>IDMAP.get(id)).filter(Number.isInteger):choosePortfolio()[end].live;
 const live=new Set(activeList),onlyPinned=$('curveOnlySelected').checked,activeHighlight=$('curveShowActive').checked;
 const show=onlyPinned?ids.filter(i=>curvePinned.has(i)):ids;
 const colors=['#ffcd76','#6ce4b5','#77c8ff','#d7a6ff','#ff8eab','#e8e8a1'];
 const gx=[],gy=[],gids=[],gnames=[],highlights=[];
 for(const id of show){
  const selected=curvePinned.has(id),active=activeHighlight&&live.has(id);
  const offset=id*(W+1),base=PREFIX[offset+90+start];
  const yy=[0,...Array.from({length:end-start+1},(_,k)=>100*Math.expm1(PREFIX[offset+90+start+k+1]-base))];
  if(!selected&&!active){
   for(let k=0;k<dates.length;k++){gx.push(dates[k]);gy.push(yy[k]);gids.push(id);gnames.push(META[id].id);}
   gx.push(null);gy.push(null);gids.push(null);gnames.push(null);
  }else{
   const j=activeList.indexOf(id),color=selected?'#fff2a8':colors[(j+colors.length)%colors.length];
   highlights.push({type:'scattergl',mode:'lines',x:dates,y:yy,name:META[id].id,meta:id,
    line:{width:selected?3.4:2.2,color},opacity:1,showlegend:false,
    hovertemplate:'%{fullData.name}<br>%{x}<br>Rendite: %{y:+.2f}%<extra></extra>'});
  }
 }
 const lines=[];
 if(gx.length)lines.push({type:'scattergl',mode:'lines',x:gx,y:gy,customdata:gids,hovertext:gnames,
   name:'Weitere Bots',showlegend:false,line:{width:.65,color:'rgba(119,155,181,0.24)'},opacity:.65,
   hovertemplate:'%{hovertext}<br>%{x}<br>Rendite: %{y:+.2f}%<extra></extra>'});
 lines.push(...highlights);
 $('curveSummary').textContent=`${state.dataset} · ${state.horizon||'YTD'} ${state.horizon?'Tage':''} · ${DATES[start]} bis ${DATES[end]} · ${ids.length} Bots · ${live.size} aktiv · ${curvePinned.size} markiert · ${show.length} Kurven (${lines.length} GPU-Spuren)`;
 Plotly.react(el,lines,{paper_bgcolor:'#0c2032',plot_bgcolor:'#0c2032',font:{color:'#c6d9e8',size:11},
  margin:{t:18,r:20,b:46,l:65},hovermode:'closest',showlegend:false,
  xaxis:{title:'Handelsdatum',gridcolor:'#294459',type:'date',automargin:true},
  yaxis:{title:'Bot-Rendite seit Fensterbeginn (%)',gridcolor:'#294459',zeroline:true,zerolinecolor:'#6c8a9e',automargin:true},
  uirevision:'botcurves-'+state.dataset+'-'+start},{responsive:true,scrollZoom:true,displaylogo:false}).then(()=>{
  if(!el._quantCurveClick){el._quantCurveClick=true;el.on('plotly_click',event=>{
   const point=event.points?.[0],id=Number.isInteger(point?.data?.meta)?point.data.meta:point?.customdata;
   if(Number.isInteger(id))toggleLinkedPin(id);
  });}
 }).catch(e=>{console.error('Bot curve error',e);$('curveSummary').textContent='Kurvenfehler: '+e.message;});
 renderCurvePins();
}
// v16: selection-only, browser-local named groups; no impact on trading or simulation.
const QUANT_GROUPS_KEY='quant_imbanalysis_named_groups_v1';
let quantGroups=[];
function groupStatus(message){$('groupStatus').textContent=message;}
function validGroupIds(ids){
 if(!Array.isArray(ids))return [];
 const valid=new Set();
 for(const id of ids){if(Number.isInteger(id)&&id>=0&&id<META.length&&META[id])valid.add(id);}
 return [...valid].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
}
function readGroups(){
 try{
  const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(QUANT_GROUPS_KEY)||'[]');
  if(!Array.isArray(saved))return [];
  return saved.filter(g=>g&&typeof g.name==='string'&&Array.isArray(g.ids)).slice(0,200).map(g=>({
   name:g.name.trim().slice(0,80),ids:validGroupIds(g.ids)
  })).filter(g=>g.name);
 }catch(e){groupStatus('Lokaler Speicher nicht verfügbar. JSON-Export weiterhin möglich.');return [];}
}
function persistGroups(){
 try{localStorage.setItem(QUANT_GROUPS_KEY,JSON.stringify(quantGroups));return true;}
 catch(e){groupStatus('Speichern im Browser blockiert: Bitte Gruppen als JSON sichern.');return false;}
}
function renderGroups(pickName){
 const picker=$('groupPicker'),selected=pickName??picker.value;
 picker.replaceChildren(new Option('Gespeicherte Gruppe auswählen',''));
 for(const g of quantGroups)picker.add(new Option(`${g.name} (${g.ids.length} Bots)`,g.name));
 if(quantGroups.some(g=>g.name===selected))picker.value=selected;
}
function applyGroup(group,append){
 if(!group)return;
 if(wf&&!confirm('Achtung: Diese gespeicherte Gruppe kann mit Kenntnis späterer Ergebnisse entstanden sein. Ihre Verwendung macht den Durchlauf möglicherweise nicht mehr blind. Trotzdem laden?'))return;
 if(!append)curvePinned.clear();
 for(const id of validGroupIds(group.ids))curvePinned.add(id);
 // Existing filters remain untouched; users can switch to 'Nur markierte Bots'.
 queueBotCurves();quantRedrawPinnedOverlay();
 groupStatus(`${append?'Hinzugefügt':'Geladen'}: ${group.name} · ${group.ids.length} Bots. ${curvePinned.size} insgesamt markiert.`);
}
function downloadGroupJSON(){
 const content=JSON.stringify({format:'quant-strategy-groups',version:1,groups:quantGroups},null,2);
 const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([content],{type:'application/json'}));
 const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='quant_strategiegruppen_backup.json';a.click();
 setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),2000);
}
function initQuantGroups(){
 quantGroups=readGroups();renderGroups();
 $('groupSave').onclick=()=>{
  const name=$('groupName').value.trim();
  if(!name){groupStatus('Bitte zuerst einen Gruppennamen eingeben.');return;}
  if(!curvePinned.size){groupStatus('Bitte zuerst Bots in 3D oder im Kurvenchart markieren.');return;}
  const index=quantGroups.findIndex(g=>g.name===name);
  if(index>=0&&!confirm(`Gruppe „${name}“ überschreiben?`))return;
  const entry={name,ids:validGroupIds([...curvePinned])};
  if(index>=0)quantGroups[index]=entry;
  else{if(quantGroups.length>=200){groupStatus('Maximal 200 Gruppen; bitte zuerst eine löschen.');return;}quantGroups.push(entry);}
  persistGroups();renderGroups(name);groupStatus(`Gespeichert: ${name} · ${entry.ids.length} Bots.`);
 };
 const selected=()=>quantGroups.find(g=>g.name===$('groupPicker').value);
 $('groupLoad').onclick=()=>{const g=selected();if(g)applyGroup(g,false);else groupStatus('Bitte eine Gruppe auswählen.');};
 $('groupAdd').onclick=()=>{const g=selected();if(g)applyGroup(g,true);else groupStatus('Bitte eine Gruppe auswählen.');};
 $('groupDelete').onclick=()=>{
  const g=selected();if(!g){groupStatus('Bitte eine Gruppe auswählen.');return;}
  if(!confirm(`Gruppe „${g.name}“ wirklich löschen?`))return;
  quantGroups=quantGroups.filter(x=>x!==g);persistGroups();renderGroups('');groupStatus(`Gruppe „${g.name}“ gelöscht.`);
 };
 $('groupExport').onclick=downloadGroupJSON;
 $('groupImport').onclick=()=>$('groupImportFile').click();
 $('groupImportFile').onchange=async()=>{
  const file=$('groupImportFile').files?.[0];if(!file)return;
  try{
   if(file.size>2_000_000)throw Error('Datei ist zu groß.');
   const parsed=JSON.parse(await file.text());
   if(parsed?.format!=='quant-strategy-groups'||parsed.version!==1||!Array.isArray(parsed.groups))throw Error('Unbekanntes JSON-Format.');
   let count=0;
   for(const g of parsed.groups.slice(0,200)){
    if(typeof g?.name!=='string'||!Array.isArray(g.ids))continue;
    const name=g.name.trim().slice(0,80);if(!name)continue;
    const entry={name,ids:validGroupIds(g.ids)};
    const i=quantGroups.findIndex(x=>x.name===name);
    if(i>=0)quantGroups[i]=entry;else if(quantGroups.length<200)quantGroups.push(entry);else break;
    count++;
   }
   persistGroups();renderGroups();groupStatus(`${count} Gruppen aus JSON importiert (gleiche Namen überschrieben).`);
  }catch(e){groupStatus('Import fehlgeschlagen: '+e.message);}
  finally{$('groupImportFile').value='';}
 };
}
function initBotCurves(){
 $('curveShowActive').onchange=queueBotCurves;
 $('curveOnlySelected').onchange=queueBotCurves;
 $('curveClear').onclick=()=>{curvePinned.clear();queueBotCurves();quantRedrawPinnedOverlay();};
 $('curveExport').onclick=()=>{
  const lines=['strategy_id,price_mode,sensitivity,box,exit_family'];
  for(const i of curvePinned){const m=META[i];lines.push([m.id,m.priceMode,m.s,m.b,m.family].join(','));}
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([lines.join('\n')],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}));
  const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='quant_markierte_strategien.csv';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),2000);
 };
 queueBotCurves();
}



// v18: retrospective selection tools; no synthetic backtest generation.
function wfKnownEnd(){return wf?wf.next-1:-1;}
function wfHistoricalReturn(i,window){
 const end=wfKnownEnd(), right=90+end+1, left=Math.max(0,right-window);
 if(right<=left)return null;
 const off=i*(W+1);
 return 100*Math.expm1(PREFIX[off+right]-PREFIX[off+left]);
}
function wfCandidateRender(){
 const info=$('wfSelectionInfo'), el=$('wfCandidates');if(!info||!el||!PREFIX)return;
 const cutoff=wfKnownEnd(), period=state.rank, family=$('wfCandidateFamily').value;
 $('wfRankWindow').textContent=period+' Tage';$('wfTopLabel').textContent=state.topCount;
 const ids=state.filtered.filter(i=>family==='all'||META[i].family===family);
 const ranked=ids.map(i=>({i,ret:wfHistoricalReturn(i,period)})).filter(x=>x.ret!==null&&Number.isFinite(x.ret)).sort((a,b)=>b.ret-a.ret);
 const startLabel=cutoff>=0?DATES[cutoff]:'Vorjahresdaten (90-Tage-Warm-up)';
 info.textContent=`Wissensstand: ${startLabel} · ${ranked.length} Kandidaten · ${curvePinned.size} markiert. Die Rangliste nutzt nur Renditen bis zu diesem Stichtag. Vorab definierte Presets und gespeicherte Gruppen können dennoch Zukunftswissen enthalten.`;
 el.innerHTML='<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse"><thead><tr><th align="left">Rang</th><th align="left">Bot</th><th align="right">Vergangenheit</th><th>Markiert</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+ranked.slice(0,60).map((a,n)=>`<tr><td>${n+1}</td><td>${META[a.i].id}</td><td align="right">${pct(a.ret)}</td><td align="center"><input type="checkbox" data-wfc="${a.i}" ${curvePinned.has(a.i)?'checked':''}></td></tr>`).join('')+'</tbody></table>';
 el.querySelectorAll('input[data-wfc]').forEach(input=>input.onchange=()=>{const id=+input.dataset.wfc;if(input.checked)curvePinned.add(id);else curvePinned.delete(id);queueBotCurves();quantRedrawPinnedOverlay();wfCandidateRender();});
}
function wfRankCandidates(){
 const n=state.topCount;
 const family=$('wfCandidateFamily').value,window=state.rank;
 const ids=state.filtered.filter(i=>family==='all'||META[i].family===family);
 const ranked=ids.map(i=>({i,ret:wfHistoricalReturn(i,window)})).filter(a=>a.ret!==null&&Number.isFinite(a.ret)&&a.ret>0).sort((a,b)=>b.ret-a.ret);
 if(!ranked.length){alert('Keine historischen Daten verfügbar.');return;}
 curvePinned.clear();ranked.slice(0,n).forEach(a=>curvePinned.add(a.i));
 queueBotCurves();quantRedrawPinnedOverlay();wfCandidateRender();
}
function wfApplySelection(){if(!wf){alert('Zuerst Durchlauf starten.');return;}if(!curvePinned.size){alert('Zuerst Bots markieren.');return;}wfRender();$('wfStatus').textContent+=' · Neue Auswahl im nächsten Abschnitt.';}

// v17 walk-forward: isolated replay, historical cutoff, immutable period decisions.
let wf=null;let wfSaved=[];let wfBusy=false;
const WF_KEY='quant_wf_runs_v1';
function wfDateIndex(end){return Math.max(0,Math.min(DAYS-1,end));}
function wfEnd(start){
 if($('wfPeriod').value==='14')return Math.min(DAYS-1,start+13);
 const month=DATES[start].slice(0,7);let i=start;
 while(i+1<DAYS&&DATES[i+1].slice(0,7)===month)i++;
 return i;
}
function wfParams(){return {period:$('wfPeriod').value,capital:Number($('wfCapital').value),allocation:Number($('wfAlloc').value)/100,leverage:Number($('wfLeverage').value)};}
function wfRulesSnapshot(){return {topCount:state.topCount,rank:state.rank,guard:state.guard,stopScope:state.stopScope,takeProfit:state.takeProfit,takePlan:state.takePlan,takeCustom:{...state.takeCustom},capitalModel:state.capitalModel,allocation:state.allocation,depotTrail:state.depotTrail,depotAction:state.depotAction,depotLock:state.depotLock,depotPause:state.depotPause,vaultProfits:state.vaultProfits,leverage:wf.leverage};}
function wfCalcFromDecisions(run,end,benchmark=false){
 const schedule=new Map(),rules=new Map();
 for(const decision of run.decisions){const idx=DATES.indexOf(decision.start);
  if(idx<0)continue;
  const selected=benchmark?(run.benchmark?.ids||[]):decision.selected;
  schedule.set(idx,validGroupIds(selected.map(x=>IDMAP.get(x))));
  rules.set(idx,decision.rules);
 }
 if(!schedule.has(0)){schedule.set(0,benchmark?validGroupIds((run.benchmark?.ids||[]).map(x=>IDMAP.get(x))):[]);rules.set(0,{...run.initialRules});}
 return simulatePortfolio({manualSchedule:schedule,ruleSchedule:rules,endDay:end,initialCapital:run.capital,allocation:run.allocation,leverage:run.leverage,execution:run.execution??'daily',capitalModel:run.capitalModel??'modern'});
}
function wfRender(){
 const status=$('wfStatus'),next=$('wfNext'),auto=$('wfAuto');
 document.body.classList.toggle('wf-locked',!!wf);for(const id of ['chart','botCurves']){const el=$(id);if(el)el.style.visibility='visible';}
 wfCandidateRender();const audit=$('wfAudit');if(audit)audit.textContent=wf?`Stichtag: ${wf.next?DATES[wf.next-1]:'Vorjahres-Warm-up'} · Nächster Handelstag: ${wf.next<DAYS?DATES[wf.next]:'Jahresende'} · Entscheidungen: ${wf.decisions.length} · Wissen aus Vergangenheit, außer evtl. importierten Gruppen.`:'Noch kein Durchlauf aktiv.';
 next.disabled=!wf||wf.next>=DAYS||wfBusy;auto.disabled=next.disabled;
 if(!wf){status.textContent='Noch kein Walk-Forward-Durchlauf gestartet.';return;}
 const end=wf.next>=DAYS?'Jahresende':DATES[wf.next];
 status.textContent=`${wf.year} · ${wf.period==='month'?'Monate':'14-Tage-Abschnitte'} · ${wf.decisions.length} abgeschlossen · ${euro(wf.wealth)} (${pct((wf.wealth/wf.capital-1)*100)}) · nächster Start: ${end} · ${curvePinned.size} markiert. ${state.capitalModel==='historical'?'Archiv: monatliche Reservefreigabe':Math.round(state.allocation*100)+' % Portfolio-Budget'} / ${wf.decisions.at(-1)?.selected.length||0} Bots.`;
 const x=wf.equity.map(a=>a.date),y=wf.equity.map(a=>a.wealth);
 Plotly.react($('wfEquity'),[{x,y,type:'scatter',mode:'lines',line:{color:'#74dfbd',width:2},name:'Manuelle Auswahl',hovertemplate:'%{x}<br>%{y:.2f} €<extra></extra>'},...(wf.benchmark?[{x:wf.benchmark.equity.map(a=>a.date),y:wf.benchmark.equity.map(a=>a.wealth),type:'scatter',mode:'lines',line:{color:'#f6bc67',width:2,dash:'dot'},name:'Feste Referenz',hovertemplate:'%{x}<br>%{y:.2f} €<extra></extra>'}]:[])],{paper_bgcolor:'#102a39',plot_bgcolor:'#102a39',font:{color:'#d8e8ee'},margin:{t:15,l:70,r:20,b:40},xaxis:{type:'date',gridcolor:'#315063'},yaxis:{title:'Depot (€)',gridcolor:'#315063'},uirevision:'wf'+wf.year},{responsive:true,displaylogo:false});
 const rows=wf.decisions.slice().reverse().map(a=>`<tr><td>${a.start} – ${a.end}</td><td>${a.selected.length}</td><td>${a.traded.length}</td><td>${euro(a.before)}</td><td>${euro(a.after)}</td><td>${pct(a.before?((a.after/a.before-1)*100):0)}</td></tr>`).join('');
 $('wfLedger').innerHTML=`<table><thead><tr><th>Zeitraum</th><th>Gewählt</th><th>Gehandelt</th><th>Vorher</th><th>Nachher</th><th>Rendite</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>`;
}
function wfStart(){
 const p=wfParams();state.allocation=p.allocation;setControls();if(!Number.isFinite(p.capital)||p.capital<=0||!Number.isFinite(p.allocation)||p.allocation<=0||p.allocation>1||!Number.isFinite(p.leverage)||p.leverage<1||p.leverage>20){alert('Ungültige Kapital-, Allokations- oder Hebelwerte.');return;}
 const benchMode=$('wfBenchMode').value;let benchIds=[];
 if(benchMode==='selection')benchIds=validGroupIds([...curvePinned]);
 if(benchMode==='group'){const g=quantGroups.find(g=>g.name===$('wfBenchGroup').value);benchIds=g?validGroupIds(g.ids):[];}
 if(benchMode!=='none'&&!benchIds.length){alert('Referenzgruppe leer. Bitte Bots markieren oder gespeicherte Gruppe wählen.');return;}
 wf={version:5,execution:state.execution,capitalModel:state.capitalModel,year:state.dataset,period:p.period,capital:p.capital,allocation:p.allocation,leverage:p.leverage,wealth:p.capital,next:0,equity:[{date:DATES[0],wealth:p.capital}],decisions:[],initialRules:{topCount:state.topCount,rank:state.rank,guard:state.guard,stopScope:state.stopScope,takeProfit:state.takeProfit,takePlan:state.takePlan,takeCustom:{...state.takeCustom},capitalModel:state.capitalModel,allocation:p.allocation,leverage:p.leverage},benchmark:benchIds.length?{source:benchMode,ids:benchIds.map(i=>META[i].id),wealth:p.capital,equity:[{date:DATES[0],wealth:p.capital}]}:null};
 for(const id of ['wfBenchMode','wfBenchGroup','wfPeriod','wfCapital','wfAlloc','wfLeverage','dataset'])$(id).disabled=true;
 setDay(0);wfRender();renderChart();queueBotCurves();
}
function wfTrade(){
 if(!wf||wfBusy||wf.next>=DAYS)return;
 if(state.dataset!==wf.year){alert('Bitte Durchlaufjahr laden.');return;}
 const selected=validGroupIds([...curvePinned]);if(!selected.length){alert('Zuerst mindestens einen Bot markieren.');return;}
 const start=wf.next,end=wfEnd(start),before=wf.wealth,rule=wfRulesSnapshot();
 const selection=selected.map(id=>META[id].id);
 const cutoff=start===0?`${Number(wf.year)-1}-12-31 (90-Tage-Warm-up)`:DATES[start-1];
 const entry={start:DATES[start],end:DATES[end],knownThrough:cutoff,selected:selection,traded:selection.slice(),before,after:before,allocation:rule.allocation,leverage:rule.leverage,rules:{...rule}};
 wf.decisions.push(entry);
 let portfolio;try{portfolio=wfCalcFromDecisions(wf,end,false);}catch(err){wf.decisions.pop();alert('Walk-Forward nicht berechnet: '+err.message);return;}
 wf.wealth=portfolio[end].wealth;
 wf.equity=[{date:DATES[0]+'T00:00:00',wealth:wf.capital},...portfolio.map(r=>({date:r.date,wealth:r.wealth}))];
 entry.after=wf.wealth;entry.traded=portfolio[start].ids.map(i=>META[i].id);
 if(wf.benchmark){const bcurve=wfCalcFromDecisions(wf,end,true);wf.benchmark.wealth=bcurve[end].wealth;
  wf.benchmark.equity=[{date:DATES[0]+'T00:00:00',wealth:wf.capital},...bcurve.map(r=>({date:r.date,wealth:r.wealth}))];
  entry.benchmarkAfter=wf.benchmark.wealth;}
 wf.next=end+1;setDay(end);wfRender();renderChart();queueBotCurves();
}
function wfReset(){wf=null;for(const id of ['wfBenchMode','wfBenchGroup'])$(id).disabled=false;document.body.classList.remove('wf-locked');for(const id of ['wfPeriod','wfCapital','wfAlloc','wfLeverage','dataset'])$(id).disabled=false;wfRender();}
function wfSave(){
 if(!wf){alert('Kein Durchlauf vorhanden.');return;}
 const name=prompt('Name für diesen Walk-Forward-Durchlauf:',`WF ${wf.year} ${wf.period} (${wf.decisions.length} Abschnitte)`);if(!name)return;
 const record={name:name.slice(0,90),run:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(wf))};
 wfSaved=wfSaved.filter(x=>x.name!==record.name);wfSaved.push(record);if(wfSaved.length>40)wfSaved.shift();
 try{localStorage.setItem(WF_KEY,JSON.stringify(wfSaved));}catch(e){alert('Browserspeicher voll/gesperrt. Bitte JSON exportieren.');}
 wfSavedRender();
}
function wfSavedRender(){const p=$('wfRunPicker');p.replaceChildren(new Option('Gespeicherte Durchläufe',''));for(let i=0;i<wfSaved.length;i++)p.add(new Option(wfSaved[i].name,String(i)));}
function wfDownload(){if(!wf&&!wfSaved.length){alert('Keine Ergebnisse vorhanden.');return;}
 const obj={format:'quant-walk-forward',version:1,current:wf,saved:wfSaved};
 const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(obj,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='quant_walk_forward.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),2000);
}
function wfInit(){
 try{const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(WF_KEY)||'[]');if(Array.isArray(v))wfSaved=v.slice(-40);}catch(e){}
 wfSavedRender();$('wfRank').onclick=wfRankCandidates;$('wfClear').onclick=()=>{$('curveClear').click();wfCandidateRender();};$('wfApply').onclick=wfApplySelection;$('wfCandidateFamily').onchange=wfCandidateRender;$('wfStart').onclick=wfStart;$('wfNext').onclick=wfTrade;
 $('wfAuto').onclick=()=>{wfTrade();}; // deliberate single-period advance: user must review/choose at every boundary
 $('wfReset').onclick=()=>{if(wf&&wf.decisions.length&&!confirm('Aktuellen Durchlauf beenden? Vorher bei Bedarf speichern.'))return;wfReset();};
 $('wfSave').onclick=wfSave;$('wfExport').onclick=wfDownload;
 $('wfRunPicker').onchange=()=>{const i=Number($('wfRunPicker').value);if($('wfRunPicker').value===''||!wfSaved[i])return;const record=wfSaved[i].run;if(record.year!==state.dataset){alert('Bitte zuerst das gespeicherte Jahr laden.');return;}if(record.version!==3){alert('Dieser alte Durchlauf wurde mit einer anderen Kapitalengine gerechnet. Bitte neuen v27-Durchlauf starten.');return;}wf=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(record));$('wfPeriod').value=wf.period;$('wfCapital').value=wf.capital;$('wfAlloc').value=wf.allocation*100;$('wfLeverage').value=wf.leverage;for(const id of ['wfPeriod','wfCapital','wfAlloc','wfLeverage','dataset','wfBenchMode','wfBenchGroup'])$(id).disabled=true;setDay(Math.max(0,wf.next-1));wfRender();renderChart();queueBotCurves();};
 $('wfImport').onclick=()=>$('wfImportFile').click();$('wfImportFile').onchange=async()=>{const f=$('wfImportFile').files?.[0];if(!f)return;try{if(f.size>5e6)throw Error('Datei zu groß');const obj=JSON.parse(await f.text());if(obj.format!=='quant-walk-forward'||obj.version!==1||!Array.isArray(obj.saved))throw Error('Unbekanntes Format');wfSaved=obj.saved.filter(v=>v&&typeof v.name==='string'&&v.run?.version===3).slice(-40);localStorage.setItem(WF_KEY,JSON.stringify(wfSaved));wfSavedRender();alert('Durchläufe importiert.');}catch(e){alert('Import fehlgeschlagen: '+e.message);}};
 wfRender();
}

async function startApp(){try{await loadYear('2026');bindUI();quantHudInit();bindSavedEvidence();initBotCurves();initQuantGroups();wfInit();window.__QUANT_V13_READY=true;}catch(e){console.error('Quant v13 failed to load',e);alert('Daten konnten nicht geladen werden: '+e.message);}}
startApp();

 const dlg=document.createElement('div');dlg.className='quantHelpDialog';dlg.id='quantHelpDialog';dlg.innerHTML='<div class="quantHelpBody" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Dashboard-Hilfe"><button type="button" id="quantHelpClose">✕</button><h2>QUANT Workspace</h2><p><b>3D-Lab:</b> Bot-Punkte anklicken, um ihre Gewinnkurven unten zu markieren. <script id="quantPipelineWorker034" type="text/plain">
'use strict';
// QUANT 0.34: local-only, streaming import + deterministic close-sampled Renko precomputation.
let resumeMonth=null;
function waitAck() {return new Promise((ok,fail)=>{resumeMonth={ok,fail};});}

 const d=e.data||{};
