 if(d.op==='renkoStart'){renkoStart(d);return;}
 if(d.op==='renkoMonth'){renkoMonth(d).catch(err=>postMessage({type:'error',message:String(err&&err.message||err)}));return;}
};
const fmtDay=n=>new Date(n*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
const alias=(s)=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/^\ufeff/,'').trim().replace(/[\s_\-()]/g,'');
const findCol=(headers,arr)=>{for(const v of arr){const j=headers.indexOf(v);if(j>=0)return j;}return -1;};
async function zipped(buffer) {if(!self.CompressionStream)throw Error('CompressionStream wird von diesem Browser nicht unterstützt.');const st=new Blob([buffer]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream('gzip'));return await new Response(st).arrayBuffer();}
async function unzipped(buffer) {if(!self.DecompressionStream)throw Error('DecompressionStream wird von diesem Browser nicht unterstützt.');const st=new Blob([buffer]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));return await new Response(st).arrayBuffer();}
async function importFile({file,symbol}){
 if(!file||!file.stream)throw Error('Datei nicht lesbar.');
 if(!self.DecompressionStream)throw Error('Für .gz wird ein aktueller Chromium-Browser benötigt.');
 let src=file.stream();if(/\.gz$/i.test(file.name))src=src.pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));
 const reader=src.getReader(),decoder=new TextDecoder('utf-8');
 let carry='',delim=null,headers=null,cols=null,days=[],month='',monthData=[],monthRows=0,monthNames=[];
 let seen=0,read=0,valid=0,invalid=0,duplicate=0,outOfOrder=0,zeroVolume=0,badOHLC=0,firstTs=null,lastTs=null,prevTs=null,observedDiffs={},maxGap=0;
 const capUnique=200;
 const colnum=(v,i)=>Number(String(v[i]??'').trim().replace(/^"|"$/g,''));
 function detect(line){
  const ds=['|',',',';','\t'];delim=ds.map(x=>[x,line.split(x).length]).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0][0];
  const cells=line.split(delim).map(s=>s.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g,''));
  const first=cells[0]||'';
  const header=!/^\d{9,16}$/.test(first)&&!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(first);
  if(header){
   headers=cells.map(alias);
   cols={t:findCol(headers,['timestamp','opentime','starttime','time','date','datetime','unix','ts','t']),o:findCol(headers,['open','o']),h:findCol(headers,['high','h']),l:findCol(headers,['low','l']),c:findCol(headers,['close','c']),v:findCol(headers,['volume','basevolume','vol','v','volumecrypto'])};
   if(['t','o','h','l','c'].some(k=>cols[k]<0))throw Error('CSV-Spalten nicht erkannt: benötigt timestamp/open/high/low/close (oder eine Header-lose Binance-Kerzendatei).');
  } else {cols={t:0,o:1,h:2,l:3,c:4,v:5};}
  return !header;
 }
 async function flushMonth(){
  if(!monthRows)return;
  const arr=new Float64Array(monthData);const compressed=await zipped(arr.buffer);
  postMessage({type:'month',month,rows:monthRows,buffer:compressed},[compressed]);
  await waitAck();monthNames.push(month);monthData=[];monthRows=0;
 }
 function handle(line){
  if(!line||!line.trim())return;
  if(!delim){if(!detect(line))return;}
  read++;
  const cells=line.split(delim);if(cells.length<5){invalid++;return;}
  const raw=(cells[cols.t]||'').trim().replace(/^"|"$/g,'');
  let ts=Number(raw);if(!Number.isFinite(ts))ts=Date.parse(raw)/1000;
  if(ts>1e14)ts/=1000000;else if(ts>1e11)ts/=1000;
  ts=Math.round(ts);
  const o=colnum(cells,cols.o),h=colnum(cells,cols.h),l=colnum(cells,cols.l),c=colnum(cells,cols.c),v=cols.v<0?0:colnum(cells,cols.v);
  if(!Number.isFinite(ts)||ts<946684800||ts>4102444800||![o,h,l,c,v].every(Number.isFinite)||o<=0||h<=0||l<=0||c<=0||v<0){invalid++;return;}
  if(h<Math.max(o,c)||l>Math.min(o,c)||h<l){badOHLC++;invalid++;return;}
  if(prevTs!==null){const diff=ts-prevTs;if(diff===0){duplicate++;return;}if(diff<0){outOfOrder++;return;}if(observedDiffs[diff]!==undefined||Object.keys(observedDiffs).length<capUnique){observedDiffs[diff]=(observedDiffs[diff]||0)+1;}maxGap=Math.max(maxGap,diff);}
  prevTs=ts;firstTs??=ts;lastTs=ts;valid++;if(v===0)zeroVolume++;
  const dayN=Math.floor(ts/86400),date=fmtDay(dayN),currentMonth=date.slice(0,7);
  if(month&&month!==currentMonth){throw {flush:true,line:[ts,o,h,l,c,v],date,dayN,day:date,newMonth:currentMonth};}
  if(!month)month=currentMonth;
  monthData.push(ts,o,h,l,c,v);monthRows++;
  const last=days[days.length-1];
  if(last&&last.date===date){last.high=Math.max(h,last.high);last.low=Math.min(l,last.low);last.close=c;last.volume+=v;last.rows++;}
  else days.push({date,open:o,high:h,low:l,close:c,volume:v,rows:1});
 }
 // We need to yield at month boundaries because the compressed cache is written before continuing.
 async function lineOf(text){
  if(!text||!text.trim())return;
  try{handle(text);}catch(exc){if(!exc||!exc.flush)throw exc;await flushMonth();month=exc.newMonth;monthData.push(...exc.line);monthRows=1;
   const {date}=exc;days.push({date,open:exc.line[1],high:exc.line[2],low:exc.line[3],close:exc.line[4],volume:exc.line[5],rows:1});}
 }
 while(true){
  const r=await reader.read();if(r.done)break;
  carry+=decoder.decode(r.value,{stream:true});
  let pos=0,end;
  while((end=carry.indexOf('\n',pos))>=0){await lineOf(carry.slice(pos,end).replace(/\r$/,''));pos=end+1;}
  carry=carry.slice(pos);
  if(valid-seen>=100000){seen=valid;postMessage({type:'progress',rows:valid,months:monthNames.length,date:lastTs?new Date(lastTs*1000).toISOString().slice(0,10):''});}
 }
 carry+=decoder.decode();if(carry.trim())await lineOf(carry.replace(/\r$/,''));await flushMonth();
 const freq=Object.entries(observedDiffs).filter(([d])=>Number(d)>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
 const interval=Number(freq[0]?.[0]||60);
 const known=Object.entries(observedDiffs).reduce((a,[delta,num])=>a+(+delta>interval?Math.max(0,Math.round(+delta/interval)-1)*num:0),0);
 const missing=Number.isFinite(known)?known:0;
 if(valid===0)throw Error('Keine gültigen OHLCV-Zeilen in der Datei.');
 postMessage({type:'complete',symbol,rows:valid,sourceRows:read,invalid,duplicate,outOfOrder,badOHLC,zeroVolume,interval,missing,maxGap,firstTs,lastTs,months:monthNames,days,format:delim,hasHeader:!!headers});
}
let rk=null;
function renkoStart({box,months}){
 const b=Number(box);if(!Number.isFinite(b)||b<=0)throw Error('Ungültige Boxgröße');
 rk={box:b,months,at:0,anchor:null,total:0,up:0,down:0,reversals:0,previousDir:0,daily:{},maxPerBar:1000};
 postMessage({type:'renkoNeed',month:months[0]});
}
async function renkoMonth({month,buffer}){
 if(!rk||rk.months[rk.at]!==month)throw Error('Renko-Monat nicht erwartet.');
 const data=new Float64Array(await unzipped(buffer)),events=[];
 for(let i=0;i<data.length;i+=6){
  const ts=data[i],close=data[i+4];if(rk.anchor===null){rk.anchor=Math.floor(close/rk.box)*rk.box;continue;}
  let bricks=0;const b=rk.box,tol=Math.max(b*1e-9,1e-12);
  function emit(dir,price){rk.anchor=Math.round(price*1e12)/1e12;events.push(ts,rk.anchor,dir);rk.total++;if(dir>0)rk.up++;else rk.down++;if(rk.previousDir&&rk.previousDir!==dir)rk.reversals++;rk.previousDir=dir;bricks++;}
  if(rk.previousDir>=0){
   if(close>=rk.anchor+b-tol){while(close>=rk.anchor+b-tol&&bricks<rk.maxPerBar)emit(1,rk.anchor+b);}
   else if(rk.previousDir===1&&close<=rk.anchor-2*b+tol){emit(-1,rk.anchor-2*b);while(close<=rk.anchor-b+tol&&bricks<rk.maxPerBar)emit(-1,rk.anchor-b);}
   else if(rk.previousDir===0&&close<=rk.anchor-b+tol){while(close<=rk.anchor-b+tol&&bricks<rk.maxPerBar)emit(-1,rk.anchor-b);}
  }else{
   if(close<=rk.anchor-b+tol){while(close<=rk.anchor-b+tol&&bricks<rk.maxPerBar)emit(-1,rk.anchor-b);}
   else if(close>=rk.anchor+2*b-tol){emit(1,rk.anchor+2*b);while(close>=rk.anchor+b-tol&&bricks<rk.maxPerBar)emit(1,rk.anchor+b);}
  }
  if(bricks){const day=fmtDay(Math.floor(ts/86400));rk.daily[day]=(rk.daily[day]||0)+bricks;}
 }
 const payload=await zipped(new Float64Array(events).buffer);
 postMessage({type:'renkoChunk',month,bricks:events.length/3,buffer:payload},[payload]);
 await waitAck();rk.at++;
 if(rk.at>=rk.months.length){postMessage({type:'renkoComplete',summary:{box:rk.box,total:rk.total,up:rk.up,down:rk.down,reversals:rk.reversals,daily:rk.daily,monthCount:rk.months.length,method:'close-sampled-fixed-box-v2-twobox'}});rk=null;}
 else postMessage({type:'renkoNeed',month:rk.months[rk.at]});
}

</script>
<script id="quantPipelineMain034">
// QUANT 0.34 — standalone browser-local multi-asset OHLCV pipeline (no network).
(function(){'use strict';
const SCHEMA=1,DB='quant-local-market-data-v1';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const nfmt=n=>Number(n||0).toLocaleString('de-DE');const efmt=n=>Number(n||0).toLocaleString('de-DE',{maximumFractionDigits:2});
let dbPromise=null,library=[],activeId=null,running=null,selectedFile=null,renkoSummary=null;
function dbOpen(){
 if(dbPromise)return dbPromise;
 dbPromise=new Promise((ok,fail)=>{
  if(!indexedDB){fail(Error('Browser unterstützt IndexedDB nicht.'));return;}
  const r=indexedDB.open(DB,SCHEMA);
  r.onupgradeneeded=()=>{
   const db=r.result;
   for(const name of ['datasets','chunks','renkoMeta','renkoChunks'])if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains(name))db.createObjectStore(name,{keyPath:name==='datasets'?'id':'key'});
  };
  r.onsuccess=()=>ok(r.result);r.onerror=()=>fail(r.error||Error('Lokalen Datenspeicher nicht geöffnet'));
 });return dbPromise;
}
async function store(name,method,val){const db=await dbOpen();return new Promise((ok,fail)=>{
 const tx=db.transaction(name,'readwrite');const obj=tx.objectStore(name);let result;
 const req=obj[method](val);req.onsuccess=()=>{result=req.result};req.onerror=()=>fail(req.error||Error('Speicherfehler'));tx.oncomplete=()=>ok(result);tx.onerror=()=>fail(tx.error||Error('Speicherfehler'));tx.onabort=()=>fail(tx.error||Error('Speicher abgebrochen'));
});}
async function get(name,key){const db=await dbOpen();return new Promise((ok,fail)=>{const r=db.transaction(name).objectStore(name).get(key);r.onsuccess=()=>ok(r.result||null);r.onerror=()=>fail(r.error);});}
async function all(name){const db=await dbOpen();return new Promise((ok,fail)=>{const r=db.transaction(name).objectStore(name).getAll();r.onsuccess=()=>ok(r.result);r.onerror=()=>fail(r.error);});}
async function deletePrefix(name,prefix){const db=await dbOpen();return new Promise((ok,fail)=>{
 const tx=db.transaction(name,'readwrite');const obj=tx.objectStore(name);const range=IDBKeyRange.bound(prefix,prefix+'\uffff');
 obj.openCursor(range).onsuccess=e=>{const cur=e.target.result;if(cur){cur.delete();cur.continue();}};
 tx.oncomplete=ok;tx.onerror=()=>fail(tx.error);
});}
const current=()=>library.find(d=>d.id===activeId)||null;
function suggestSymbol(name){const s=name.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,'');
 const m=s.match(/(SOL|BTC|XBT|ETH|ADA|XRP|DOGE|BNB|AVAX|LINK|DOT)(USDT|USD|EUR|USDC)/);
 return m?m[0].replace('XBT','BTC'):'';}
function recommendedBox(symbol){return /BTC|XBT/.test(symbol)?50:/ETH/.test(symbol)?5:0.1;}
function setStateLabel(msg,bad=false){const el=$('quantDataStatus');if(el){el.textContent=msg;el.classList.toggle('bad',bad);}}
function isBusy(){return !!running;}
function refreshButtons(){const busy=isBusy(), ds=!!current();
 for(const id of ['quantDataImport','quantDataRenko','quantDataDelete','quantDataExport','quantDataExportDaily','quantDataExportBars'])if($(id))$(id).disabled=busy||(['quantDataImport'].includes(id)?!selectedFile:!ds);
 $('quantDataCancel').hidden=!busy;
 $('quantDataRenko').disabled=busy||!ds;
 $('quantDataBox').disabled=busy;}
function fileSelect(f){selectedFile=f||null;if(f){const sym=suggestSymbol(f.name);if(sym){$('quantDataSymbol').value=sym;$('quantDataBox').value=recommendedBox(sym);}}
 $('quantDataFileName').textContent=f?`${f.name} · ${(f.size/1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`:'CSV oder CSV.GZ auswählen oder hier ablegen';refreshButtons();}
function qualityHTML(ds){
 const q=ds.quality||{},interval=q.interval||60;const issues=[];
 if(q.duplicate)issues.push(`${nfmt(q.duplicate)} doppelte Zeitstempel`);
 if(q.outOfOrder)issues.push(`${nfmt(q.outOfOrder)} ungeordnete Zeilen`);
 if(q.invalid)issues.push(`${nfmt(q.invalid)} ungültige Kerzen`);
 if(q.missing)issues.push(`${nfmt(q.missing)} vermutete fehlende Intervalle`);
 if(!issues.length)issues.push('Keine Fehler in den geprüften Daten erkannt');
 const dates=ds.firstDate+' – '+ds.lastDate;
 return `<div class="qdp-kpis"><div><small>Kerzen</small><strong>${nfmt(ds.rows)}</strong></div><div><small>Auflösung</small><strong>${interval%60===0?`${interval/60} min`:`${interval} s`}</strong></div><div><small>UTC-Zeitraum</small><strong style="font-size:12px">${dates}</strong></div><div><small>Monats-Shards</small><strong>${ds.months.length}</strong></div></div>
  <div class="qdp-quality">${issues.map(i=>`<span>${esc(i)}</span>`).join('')}<span>${nfmt(q.zeroVolume||0)} Kerzen ohne Volumen</span></div>`;
}
function lineSvg(days){if(!days||days.length<2)return '<div class="qdp-muted">Noch keine Daten</div>';
 const vals=days.map(x=>x.close);let mi=Math.min(...vals),ma=Math.max(...vals);if(mi===ma)ma=mi+1;
 const step=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(vals.length/650)),dots=[];for(let i=0;i<vals.length;i+=step){const x=(i/(vals.length-1))*850,y=160-((vals[i]-mi)/(ma-mi))*138;dots.push(`${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`);}
 dots.push(`850,${(160-((vals.at(-1)-mi)/(ma-mi))*138).toFixed(1)}`);
 return `<svg role="img" aria-label="Täglicher Schlusskurs über den importierten Zeitraum" viewBox="0 0 850 185" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="0" y1="160" x2="850" y2="160" stroke="#23475a"/><polyline points="${dots.join(' ')}" stroke="#66ddc8" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/></svg><div class="qdp-chartlabels"><span>${days[0].date}</span><b>${esc(current()?.symbol||'')} · Schlusskurse</b><span>${days.at(-1).date}</span></div>`;
}
async function render(){
 const grid=$('quantDataLibrary'),sel=$('quantDataSelected');library.sort((a,b)=>b.importedAt.localeCompare(a.importedAt));
 grid.innerHTML=library.length?library.map(ds=>`<button class="qdp-dataset ${ds.id===activeId?'active':''}" data-ds="${esc(ds.id)}"><span><strong>${esc(ds.symbol)}</strong><small>${esc(ds.firstDate)} – ${esc(ds.lastDate)}</small></span><span class="qdp-datacount">${nfmt(ds.rows)} Kerzen</span></button>`).join(''):'<div class="qdp-muted">Noch keine Marktdaten geladen.</div>';
 grid.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{activeId=b.dataset.ds;renkoSummary=null;render();});
 const ds=current();if(!ds){sel.innerHTML='<div class="qdp-muted">Wähle eine CSV-Datei und importiere sie in den lokalen Speicher.</div>';$('quantDataPreview').innerHTML='';$('quantDataRenkoInfo').textContent='Noch keine Renko-Vorberechnung.';refreshButtons();return;}
 sel.innerHTML=`<div class="qdp-selectedtitle">${esc(ds.symbol)} <span>· ${esc(ds.sourceName)}</span></div>${qualityHTML(ds)}<div class="qdp-model">UTC · ${esc(ds.format)}-getrennt · ${ds.hasHeader?'mit':'ohne'} Kopfzeile · ${nfmt(ds.quality.sourceRows||ds.rows)} Rohzeilen</div>`;
 $('quantDataPreview').innerHTML=lineSvg(ds.days);
 const b=Number($('quantDataBox').value),saved=renkoSummary&&renkoSummary.key===`${ds.id}|${b}`?renkoSummary:await get('renkoMeta',`${ds.id}|${b}`);
 $('quantDataRenkoInfo').textContent=saved&&saved.method==='close-sampled-fixed-box-v2-twobox'?`${nfmt(saved.total)} Zwei-Box-Renko-Bricks · ${nfmt(saved.reversals)} Richtungswechsel · ${saved.box} USD/Brick`:saved?'Alter Renko-Cache mit Ein-Box-Umkehr: bitte neu berechnen (v0.36).':'Für diese Boxgröße noch keine Renko-Daten berechnet.';
 refreshButtons();
}
async function loadLibrary(){try{library=await all('datasets');if(!activeId&&library.length)activeId=library.sort((a,b)=>b.importedAt.localeCompare(a.importedAt))[0].id;await render();}
 catch(e){setStateLabel('Lokaler Cache nicht verfügbar: '+e.message,true);}}
function makeWorker(){
 const src=$('quantPipelineWorker034').textContent;
 return new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src],{type:'text/javascript'})));
}
async function importStart(){
 if(running||!selectedFile)return;
 const file=selectedFile,sym=$('quantDataSymbol').value.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9_\-]/g,'');
 if(!/^[A-Z0-9_\-]{3,20}$/.test(sym)){setStateLabel('Bitte ein gültiges Symbol wie SOLUSDT oder BTCUSDT eingeben.',true);return;}
 if(!(/\.(csv|txt)(?:\([^)]*\))?(?:\.gz)?$/i.test(file.name)||/\.gz$/i.test(file.name))){setStateLabel('Bitte .csv, .txt oder .csv.gz auswählen.',true);return;}
 const id=`${sym}|${file.name}|${file.size}|${file.lastModified}`;
 if(library.some(x=>x.id===id)){activeId=id;setStateLabel('Diese Datei ist bereits im Cache.');await render();return;}
 let worker;try{await dbOpen();worker=makeWorker();}catch(e){setStateLabel(e.message,true);return;}
 running={kind:'import',id,worker};refreshButtons();setStateLabel('Import gestartet – Entpacken, Validieren und in Monats-Shards speichern …');
 let processedMonths=0,done=false;
 async function cleanup(){await deletePrefix('chunks',id+'|').catch(()=>{});}
 worker.onerror=async e=>{if(done)return;done=true;worker.terminate();await cleanup();running=null;refreshButtons();setStateLabel('Worker-Fehler: '+(e.message||'unbekannt'),true);};
 worker.onmessage=async e=>{
  const m=e.data;
  if(done)return;
  try{
   if(m.type==='month'){await store('chunks','put',{key:id+'|'+m.month,id,month:m.month,rows:m.rows,buffer:m.buffer});processedMonths++;worker.postMessage({op:'ack'});return;}
   if(m.type==='progress'){setStateLabel(`${nfmt(m.rows)} Kerzen geprüft · ${processedMonths} Monats-Shards · bis ${m.date} …`);return;}
   if(m.type==='complete'){
    const meta={id,symbol:sym,sourceName:file.name,size:file.size,importedAt:new Date().toISOString(),firstDate:new Date(m.firstTs*1000).toISOString().slice(0,10),lastDate:new Date(m.lastTs*1000).toISOString().slice(0,10),months:m.months,days:m.days,rows:m.rows,quality:{sourceRows:m.sourceRows,invalid:m.invalid,duplicate:m.duplicate,outOfOrder:m.outOfOrder,badOHLC:m.badOHLC,zeroVolume:m.zeroVolume,interval:m.interval,missing:m.missing,maxGap:m.maxGap},format:m.format,hasHeader:m.hasHeader,schema:SCHEMA};
    await store('datasets','put',meta);done=true;worker.terminate();running=null;library.push(meta);activeId=id;renkoSummary=null;setStateLabel(`${nfmt(m.rows)} Kerzen importiert und lokal in ${m.months.length} Monaten gespeichert.`);await render();return;
   }
   if(m.type==='error')throw Error(m.message);
  }catch(err){if(done)return;done=true;worker.terminate();await cleanup();running=null;refreshButtons();setStateLabel('Import fehlgeschlagen: '+err.message,true);}
 };
 worker.postMessage({op:'import',file,symbol:sym});
}
async function renkoStart(){
 const ds=current(),box=Number($('quantDataBox').value);if(running||!ds)return;
 if(!Number.isFinite(box)||box<=0||box>100000){setStateLabel('Boxgröße ungültig.',true);return;}
 const key=`${ds.id}|${box}`;let worker;try{worker=makeWorker();}catch(e){setStateLabel(e.message,true);return;}
 running={kind:'renko',id:ds.id,box,worker};refreshButtons();setStateLabel(`Close-Renko ${box} USD vorbereiten …`);
 let written=0,done=false;
 async function cleanup(){await deletePrefix('renkoChunks',key+'|').catch(()=>{});}
 worker.onerror=async e=>{if(done)return;done=true;worker.terminate();await cleanup();running=null;refreshButtons();setStateLabel('Renko-Fehler: '+e.message,true);};
 worker.onmessage=async e=>{
  const m=e.data;if(done)return;
  try{
   if(m.type==='renkoNeed'){
    const rec=await get('chunks',ds.id+'|'+m.month);if(!rec)throw Error('Monats-Cache fehlt: '+m.month);
    worker.postMessage({op:'renkoMonth',month:m.month,buffer:rec.buffer},[rec.buffer]);return;
   }
   if(m.type==='renkoChunk'){
    await store('renkoChunks','put',{key:key+'|'+m.month,dsId:ds.id,box,month:m.month,bricks:m.bricks,buffer:m.buffer});written++;setStateLabel(`Renko ${box} USD · Monat ${written}/${ds.months.length} · ${nfmt(m.bricks)} Bricks in diesem Monat`);worker.postMessage({op:'ack'});return;
   }
   if(m.type==='renkoComplete'){
    renkoSummary={key,dsId:ds.id,symbol:ds.symbol,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),...m.summary};await store('renkoMeta','put',renkoSummary);
    done=true;worker.terminate();running=null;setStateLabel(`${nfmt(renkoSummary.total)} Renko-Bricks gebaut · ${ds.symbol} · ${box} USD (Close-Sampling).`);await render();return;
   }
   if(m.type==='error')throw Error(m.message);
  }catch(err){if(done)return;done=true;worker.terminate();await cleanup();running=null;refreshButtons();setStateLabel('Renko-Berechnung fehlgeschlagen: '+err.message,true);}
 };
 worker.postMessage({op:'renkoStart',months:ds.months,box});
}
async function delCurrent(){const ds=current();if(!ds||running)return;if(!confirm(`Datensatz ${ds.symbol} (${ds.sourceName}) inklusive aller Monats-/Renko-Dateien lokal löschen?`))return;
 setStateLabel('Lokale Daten werden gelöscht …');await deletePrefix('chunks',ds.id+'|');await deletePrefix('renkoChunks',ds.id+'|');await deletePrefix('renkoMeta',ds.id+'|');await store('datasets','delete',ds.id);
 library=library.filter(x=>x.id!==ds.id);activeId=library[0]?.id||null;renkoSummary=null;await render();setStateLabel('Datensatz und Caches gelöscht.');}
function download(data,filename,type){const blob=data instanceof Blob?data:new Blob([data],{type});const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=filename;document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),10000);}
function downloadMeta(){const ds=current();if(!ds)return;download(JSON.stringify({format:'quant-market-data',schema:1,source:ds,renkoNote:'Das ist ein Metadatenexport, kein OHLCV-Candle-Export.'},null,2),`${ds.symbol}_quant_data_manifest.json`,'application/json');}
function exportDaily(){const ds=current();if(!ds)return;const lines=['date,open,high,low,close,volume,rows'];for(const d of ds.days)lines.push(`${d.date},${d.open},${d.high},${d.low},${d.close},${d.volume},${d.rows}`);download(lines.join('\n'),`${ds.symbol}_daily_summary.csv`,'text/csv');}
async function unzip(buffer){const st=new Blob([buffer]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));return await new Response(st).arrayBuffer();}
async function exportBars(){const ds=current();if(!ds||running)return;const box=Number($('quantDataBox').value),key=`${ds.id}|${box}`,meta=await get('renkoMeta',key);
 if(!meta||meta.method!=='close-sampled-fixed-box-v2-twobox'){setStateLabel('Renko bitte mit v0.36 neu berechnen (Zwei-Box-Umkehr).',true);return;}
 const lines=['timestamp_utc,brick_close,direction'];let count=0;
 const threshold=Date.parse(ds.lastDate+'T00:00:00Z')/1000-13*86400;
 for(const month of ds.months){const r=await get('renkoChunks',key+'|'+month);if(!r)continue;const a=new Float64Array(await unzip(r.buffer));for(let i=0;i<a.length;i+=3)if(a[i]>=threshold){lines.push(`${new Date(a[i]*1000).toISOString()},${a[i+1].toFixed(8)},${a[i+2]>0?'up':'down'}`);count++;}}
 download(lines.join('\n'),`${ds.symbol}_renko_${box}_last14days.csv`,'text/csv');setStateLabel(`${nfmt(count)} Renko-Bricks (letzte 14 Tage) exportiert.`);
}
async function updateSpace(){try{if(!navigator.storage?.estimate)return;const s=await navigator.storage.estimate(),u=(s.usage/1048576).toFixed(0),q=(s.quota/1048576).toFixed(0);$('quantDataStorage').textContent=`Lokaler Browser-Cache: ${u} MB von ca. ${q} MB verfügbarer Quota belegt.`;}catch(_){}}
function modal(show){const m=$('quantDataDialog');m.hidden=!show;document.body.classList.toggle('qdp-open',show);if(show){loadLibrary();updateSpace();}}
function init(){
 if($('quantDataOpen'))return;
 const nav=$('quantNavV20');const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.id='quantDataOpen';btn.type='button';btn.className='qdp-navlink';btn.innerHTML='<span aria-hidden="true">▤</span> Datenpipeline';btn.title='Marktdaten (SOL, BTC und andere Assets) lokal verwalten';btn.onclick=()=>modal(true);
 if(nav){nav.insertBefore(btn,nav.querySelector('.spacer'));}else document.querySelector('.wrap>header')?.append(btn);
 const file=$('quantDataFile'),area=$('quantDataDrop');file.onchange=()=>fileSelect(file.files?.[0]);area.onclick=e=>{if(e.target.tagName==='INPUT')return;file.click();};area.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();file.click();}};
 area.ondragover=e=>{e.preventDefault();area.classList.add('over')};area.ondragleave=()=>area.classList.remove('over');area.ondrop=e=>{e.preventDefault();area.classList.remove('over');fileSelect(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);};
 $('quantDataClose').onclick=()=>modal(false);$('quantDataBackdrop').onclick=()=>modal(false);
 $('quantDataImport').onclick=importStart;$('quantDataRenko').onclick=renkoStart;$('quantDataDelete').onclick=delCurrent;$('quantDataExport').onclick=downloadMeta;$('quantDataExportDaily').onclick=exportDaily;$('quantDataExportBars').onclick=exportBars;
 $('quantDataCancel').onclick=async()=>{const r=running;if(!r)return;r.worker.terminate();running=null;if(r.kind==='import')await deletePrefix('chunks',r.id+'|');else await deletePrefix('renkoChunks',`${r.id}|${r.box}|`);refreshButtons();setStateLabel('Vorgang abgebrochen. Bereits vorhandene Datensätze bleiben erhalten.');};
 $('quantDataBox').onchange=()=>{renkoSummary=null;render();};$('quantDataSymbol').onchange=()=>{const v=$('quantDataSymbol').value.toUpperCase();$('quantDataBox').value=recommendedBox(v);};
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&!$('quantDataDialog').hidden)modal(false);});
 window.QUANT_DATA_PIPELINE={open:()=>modal(true),list:()=>library.map(({id,symbol,rows,firstDate,lastDate})=>({id,symbol,rows,firstDate,lastDate})),getMonthly:async(id,month)=>{const d=await get('chunks',id+'|'+month);return d?new Float64Array(await unzip(d.buffer)):null;},getRenkoMonthly:async(id,box,month)=>{const d=await get('renkoChunks',`${id}|${box}|${month}`);return d?new Float64Array(await unzip(d.buffer)):null;},getManifest:async(id)=>get('datasets',id)};
 refreshButtons();loadLibrary();
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);else init();
})();

</script>
<section id="q36Dialog" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="QUANT Intraday Research 0.36">
 <div id="q36Backdrop"></div>
 <div class="q36-shell">
  <div class="q36-head"><div><span class="q36-eyebrow">QUANT / INTRADAY RESEARCH · 0.36</span><h2>Minutenbasierte Signale & Risikoschutz</h2><p>Lokale OHLCV-Daten → Renko/IMBA → nächste Minutenöffnung → Stop-Market-Modell. Keine TradingView-/Tick-Parität.</p></div><button type="button" id="q36Close" aria-label="Schließen">✕</button></div>
  <div class="q36-control">
   <label>Datensatz <select id="q36Dataset"></select></label>
   <label>Bis einschließlich (UTC) <input type="date" id="q36End"/></label>
   <label>Handelsfenster <select id="q36Days"><option value="7">7 Tage</option><option selected value="14">14 Tage</option><option value="30">30 Tage</option><option value="90">90 Tage</option></select></label>
   <label>Signalquelle <select id="q36Source"><option value="5m" selected>5m bestätigt</option><option value="1m">1m bestätigt</option></select></label>
   <label>Preis-Stop <select id="q36Stop"><option value="0">Aus</option><option value="1">1 %</option><option value="2" selected>2 %</option><option value="3">3 %</option><option value="5">5 %</option><option value="8">8 %</option><option value="10">10 %</option></select></label>
   <label>Trailing <select id="q36Trail"><option value="0" selected>Aus</option><option value="0.5">0,5 %</option><option value="1">1 %</option><option value="2">2 %</option><option value="3">3 %</option></select></label>
   <label>Trail aktiv ab <select id="q36Activation"><option value="0" selected>Sofort</option><option value="1">+1 %</option><option value="2">+2 %</option><option value="3">+3 %</option></select></label>
   <label>Take-Profit <select id="q36Take"><option value="gene" selected>Strategie-Gen (TP)</option><option value="off">Aus</option><option value="1">+1 %</option><option value="2">+2 %</option><option value="3">+3 %</option><option value="5">+5 %</option><option value="10">+10 %</option></select></label>
   <label>Hebel <select id="q36Lev"><option value="1">1×</option><option value="3">3×</option><option value="5">5×</option><option value="10" selected>10×</option></select></label>
   <label>Portfolio-Budget <select id="q36Alloc"><option value="10">10 %</option><option value="20">20 %</option><option value="50">50 %</option><option value="100" selected>100 %</option></select></label>
   <label>Gebühr / Seite <select id="q36Fee"><option value="0">0 %</option><option value="0.02">0,02 %</option><option selected value="0.06">0,06 %</option><option value="0.1">0,10 %</option></select></label>
   <label>Slippage / Seite <select id="q36Slip"><option value="0">0 %</option><option selected value="0.03">0,03 %</option><option value="0.1">0,10 %</option></select></label>
  </div>
  <div class="q36-actions"><span id="q36BotInfo">Bitte im 3D-Chart Bots markieren.</span><button type="button" id="q36Run">Intraday-Vergleich berechnen</button><button type="button" id="q36Export">Trades als CSV</button></div>
  <div id="q36Status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Noch nicht berechnet.</div>
  <section id="q36Results" hidden>
   <div id="q36Kpis"></div><div id="q36Chart"></div>
   <h3>Strategien und Stop-Vergleich</h3><div class="q36-scroll" id="q36Table"></div>
   <h3>Jüngste abgeschlossene Trades · mit Schutz</h3><div class="q36-scroll" id="q36Trades"></div>
  </section>
  <p class="q36-caveat">Forschungsmodell: Renko aus bestätigten 1m-/5m-Schlusskursen, IMBA auf Hoch-/Tiefzonen mit Lookback Sensitivity × 10. Signal nach Quellbarschluss, Ausführung zum nächsten Minuten-Open. Stops an Minuten-High/Low, Stop vor TP bei Kollision; ungünstige Open-Gaps werden berücksichtigt. Trailing-Level werden erst nach Abschluss der Minute angepasst. Warmup maximal 120 Tage, Renko-Anker dadurch ggf. abweichend. Kein Spread-Orderbuch, Funding, Maintenance-Margin oder TV-Tick-Paritätsnachweis. Das eingestellte Portfolio-Budget wird auf die markierten Bots gleichgewichtet verteilt; ihre virtuellen Einzelkapitalverläufe werden gemittelt. **Nicht** das historische Top-6-Depot (keine globale Kapital-Neugewichtung/Staffeln). TTP-Gene werden als Trailing-Stop nach der Aktivierung modelliert (ohne sofortige Gegenposition), nicht als exakte historische Flip-/Reentry-Engine. Für TP-Gene gilt Full-Exit am TP und Re-Entry erst beim nächsten Flip.</p>
 </div>
</section>

<script id="q36JS">
/* QUANT 0.36 — research-only, confirmed-source 1m/5m IMBA + minute OHLC stop model.
   Core formula modeled after quant/src/quant/strategies/imba.py, Renko 2-box reversals
   modeled after quant/src/quant/features/renko.py. NOT TradingView/tick/execution parity.
*/
(function(){'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const fmt=(v,d=2)=>Number(v).toLocaleString('de-DE',{minimumFractionDigits:d,maximumFractionDigits:d});
const money=v=>fmt(v,2)+' €';
const pct=v=>(v>=0?'+':'')+fmt(v,2)+' %';
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const dayStr=ts=>new Date(ts*1000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
const iso=ts=>new Date(ts*1000).toISOString().replace('T',' ').slice(0,16)+' UTC';
let latest=null, busy=false, cancel=false;
const eligibleModes=['renko_usd','renko_pct','candle'];
const U={
 // OHLC source rows use [ts,open,high,low,close,volume]
 async loadData(ds,startTs,endTs){
  const api=window.QUANT_DATA_PIPELINE;
  if(!api)throw Error('Datenpipeline 0.34 ist noch nicht bereit.');
  const m=await api.getManifest(ds);
  if(!m)throw Error('Datensatz nicht im lokalen Cache gefunden.');
  const months=m.months.filter(x=>{const base=Date.parse(x+'-01T00:00:00Z')/1000;
   const y=+x.slice(0,4),mo=+x.slice(5,7),next=Date.UTC(y,mo,1)/1000;
   return next>startTs&&base<endTs;});
  if(!months.length)throw Error('Für diesen Zeitraum fehlen Monatsdaten.');
  const records=[];
  for(let k=0;k<months.length;k++){
   if(cancel)throw Error('Abgebrochen.');
   msg('Lade Monatsdaten '+(k+1)+'/'+months.length+' · '+months[k]+' …');
   const arr=await api.getMonthly(ds,months[k]);
   if(!arr)throw Error('Monats-Cache fehlt: '+months[k]);
   for(let j=0;j<arr.length;j+=6)if(arr[j]>=startTs&&arr[j]<endTs)records.push([arr[j],arr[j+1],arr[j+2],arr[j+3],arr[j+4]]);
   await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));
  }
  if(!records.length)throw Error('Keine Minutenkerzen im angegebenen Fenster.');
  records.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]);
  // Reject wrong interval: 1-minute execution requires one-minute source.
  let interval=0;for(let i=1;i<Math.min(records.length,1000);i++){const d=records[i][0]-records[i-1][0];if(d>0){interval=d;break;}}
  if(interval!==60)throw Error('Intraday-Execution benötigt 1-Minuten-OHLCV. Erkannt: '+interval+' Sekunden.');
  return records;
 },
 signalMap(bars,bot,source){
  const signals=new Int8Array(bars.length),lookback=Math.max(2,Math.round(bot.s*10));
  const highQ=[],lowQ=[];let hiHead=0,loHead=0,k=0,trend=0,ready=false,renkoClose=null,renkoDir=0;
  const hVals=[],lVals=[];
  function newSignal(idx,high,low,close){
   while(highQ.length>hiHead&&hVals[highQ[highQ.length-1]]<=high)highQ.pop();
   while(lowQ.length>loHead&&lVals[lowQ[lowQ.length-1]]>=low)lowQ.pop();
   hVals.push(high);lVals.push(low);highQ.push(k);lowQ.push(k);
   const before=k-lookback;
   while(hiHead<highQ.length&&highQ[hiHead]<=before)hiHead++;
   while(loHead<lowQ.length&&lowQ[loHead]<=before)loHead++;
   if(k>=lookback-1){
    const max=hVals[highQ[hiHead]],min=lVals[lowQ[loHead]],range=max-min;
    const long=close>=max-range*.236,short=close<=max-range*.786;
    if(long||short){const want=long&&!short?1:short&&!long?-1:ready?trend:1;
     if(!ready){trend=want;ready=true;}else if(want!==trend){trend=want;signals[idx]=want;}
    }
   }
   k++;
   if(hiHead>4000){highQ.splice(0,hiHead);hiHead=0;}
   if(loHead>4000){lowQ.splice(0,loHead);loHead=0;}
  }
  let brickCount=0,reversals=0,lastTimestamp=null,maxPerBar=1000,prevGroup=-1,agg=null;
  function emitRenko(idx,price,ts){
   if(!Number.isFinite(price)||price<=0)return;
   const fixed=bot.priceMode!=='renko_pct';
   const unit=bot.b;
   if(renkoClose===null){renkoClose=fixed?Math.floor((price+Math.max(price,unit,1)*1e-12)/unit)*unit:price;return;}
   let emitted=0;
   function brick(dir,o,c){
    if(emitted++>=maxPerBar)throw Error('Zu viele Renko-Bricks in einer Kerze; Boxgröße prüfen.');
    if(renkoDir&&dir!==renkoDir)reversals++;
    renkoDir=dir;renkoClose=c;brickCount++;
    newSignal(idx,Math.max(o,c),Math.min(o,c),c);
   }
   const step=()=>fixed?unit:renkoClose*unit/100;
   // With percent boxes, the 2-box reversal threshold uses the prior brick's % width;
   // this is a research approximation, not an exact vendor's percent-Renko geometry.
   let box=step(),tol=Math.max(1e-12,box*1e-9);
   if(renkoDir>=0){
    if(price>=renkoClose+box-tol){
     while(price>=renkoClose+box-tol){const o=renkoClose;brick(1,o,o+box);box=step();tol=Math.max(1e-12,box*1e-9);}
    }else if(renkoDir===1&&price<=renkoClose-2*box+tol){
     const o=renkoClose-box;brick(-1,o,renkoClose-2*box);box=step();tol=Math.max(1e-12,box*1e-9);
     while(price<=renkoClose-box+tol){const o=renkoClose;brick(-1,o,o-box);box=step();tol=Math.max(1e-12,box*1e-9);}
    }else if(renkoDir===0&&price<=renkoClose-box+tol){
     while(price<=renkoClose-box+tol){const o=renkoClose;brick(-1,o,o-box);box=step();tol=Math.max(1e-12,box*1e-9);}
    }
   }else{
    if(price<=renkoClose-box+tol){
     while(price<=renkoClose-box+tol){const o=renkoClose;brick(-1,o,o-box);box=step();tol=Math.max(1e-12,box*1e-9);}
    }else if(price>=renkoClose+2*box-tol){
     const o=renkoClose+box;brick(1,o,renkoClose+2*box);box=step();tol=Math.max(1e-12,box*1e-9);
     while(price>=renkoClose+box-tol){const o=renkoClose;brick(1,o,o+box);box=step();tol=Math.max(1e-12,box*1e-9);}
    }
   }
  }
  function flushAgg(){if(!agg)return;
   if(bot.priceMode==='candle')newSignal(agg.idx,agg.h,agg.l,agg.c);
   else emitRenko(agg.idx,agg.c,agg.ts);
  }
  for(let i=0;i<bars.length;i++){
   if(cancel)throw Error('Abgebrochen.');
   const b=bars[i],key=source==='1m'?i:Math.floor(b[0]/300);
   if(key!==prevGroup){flushAgg();agg={idx:i,ts:b[0],o:b[1],h:b[2],l:b[3],c:b[4]};prevGroup=key;}
   else{agg.idx=i;agg.ts=b[0];agg.h=Math.max(agg.h,b[2]);agg.l=Math.min(agg.l,b[3]);agg.c=b[4];}
  }
  flushAgg();
  return {signals,bricks:brickCount,reversals,lookback,signalCount:signals.reduce((n,x)=>n+(x!==0),0)};
 },
 simulate(bars,signals,firstTs,lastTs,opt){
  const startIdx=bars.findIndex(b=>b[0]>=firstTs);
  if(startIdx<0)throw Error('Kein Einstiegstag in den Marktdaten.');
  const fee=Math.max(0,opt.fee/100),slip=Math.max(0,opt.slip/100),lever=opt.leverage,alloc=opt.alloc/100;
  const stopP=opt.stop/100,trailP=opt.trail/100;
  const takeP=opt.take/100;
  let balance=1000,qty=0,side=0,entry=0,entryTime=0,entryFee=0,extreme=0,trailActivated=false;
  let pending=0,activeStop=0,stops=0,tps=0,flips=0,bankrupt=false;
  const curve=[],trades=[];
  const tradeExit=(t,px,reason)=>{
   if(!side)return;
   const fill=px*(1-side*slip),value=qty*side*(fill-entry),exitFee=Math.abs(qty*fill)*fee;
   balance+=value-exitFee;
   if(balance<=0){balance=0;bankrupt=true;reason='KAPITAL ERSCHÖPFT (Modell)';}
   trades.push({bot:opt.botName,entryTime,exitTime:t,side:side>0?'Long':'Short',entryPrice:entry,exitPrice:fill,net:value-entryFee-entryFee,reason});
   if(reason==='Stop' || reason==='Trailing-Stop')stops++;
   if(reason==='Take-Profit')tps++;
   if(reason==='Signalwechsel')flips++;
   qty=0;side=0;entry=0;entryFee=0;activeStop=0;trailActivated=false;
  };
  const tradeEntry=(t,px,newSide)=>{
   if(balance<=0)return;
   const fill=px*(1+newSide*slip);
   const notional=balance*alloc*lever;
   if(notional<=0)return;
   qty=notional/fill;side=newSide;entry=fill;entryTime=t;entryFee=notional*fee;
   balance-=entryFee;extreme=fill;trailActivated=false;activeStop=0;
  };
  let nextPoint=firstTs-1,lastMark=null;
  for(let i=startIdx;i<bars.length;i++){
   if(cancel)throw Error('Abgebrochen.');
   const b=bars[i],t=b[0];if(t>=lastTs)break;
   const open=b[1],high=b[2],low=b[3],close=b[4];
   if(pending&&!bankrupt){if(side&&side!==pending)tradeExit(t,open,'Signalwechsel');if(!side)tradeEntry(t,open,pending);pending=0;}
   if(side&&!bankrupt){
    const fixed=stopP>0?(side===1?entry*(1-stopP):entry*(1+stopP)):null;
    const trailing=trailP>0&&trailActivated?(side===1?extreme*(1-trailP):extreme*(1+trailP)):null;
    let stop= fixed===null?trailing:trailing===null?fixed:(side>0?Math.max(fixed,trailing):Math.min(fixed,trailing));
    const hitStop=stop!==null&&(side>0?low<=stop:high>=stop);
    const profit=takeP>0?(side>0?entry*(1+takeP):entry*(1-takeP)):null;
    const hitTake=profit!==null&&(side>0?high>=profit:low<=profit);
    // If high and low both touch in one minute, stop is conservatively filled first.
    if(hitStop){const gap=side>0?open<stop:open>stop;tradeExit(t,gap?open:stop,trailing!==null&&(side>0?stop===trailing:stop===trailing)?'Trailing-Stop':'Stop');}
    else if(hitTake){const gap=side>0?open>profit:open<profit;tradeExit(t,gap?open:profit,'Take-Profit');}
    else if(qty>0 && (side>0?low<=entry-balance/qty:high>=entry+balance/qty)){
     // Hypothetical account-zero boundary. Not venue liquidation/margin mechanics.
     const zero=side>0?entry-balance/qty:entry+balance/qty;
     tradeExit(t,(side>0?open<zero:open>zero)?open:zero,'KAPITAL ERSCHÖPFT (Modell)');
    }else{
     // Updating trail after this minute prevents same-minute high/low ordering lookahead.
     extreme=side>0?Math.max(extreme,high):Math.min(extreme,low);
     if(trailP>0&&((side>0?extreme/entry-1:entry/extreme-1)>=opt.trailActivate/100))trailActivated=true;
     // When underlying movement would consume all modeled equity, do not claim an exchange liquidation fill.
     if(balance+qty*side*(close-entry)<=0){tradeExit(t,close,'KAPITAL ERSCHÖPFT (Modell)');}
    }
   }
   const eq=Math.max(0,balance+(side?qty*side*(close-entry):0));
   lastMark=[t,eq];
   if(t>=nextPoint){curve.push([t,eq]);nextPoint=t+Math.max(60,Math.round(opt.chartStepMinutes))*60;}
   // Signals arise only from completed source bars, executed at the next minute's OPEN.
   if(signals[i])pending=signals[i];
   if(bankrupt)pending=0;
  }
  if(lastMark&&curve.at(-1)?.[0]!==lastMark[0])curve.push(lastMark);
  const last=curve[curve.length-1]||[firstTs,balance];
  const final=last[1];let peak=1000,dd=0;
  for(const x of [[firstTs,1000],...curve]){peak=Math.max(peak,x[1]);if(peak>0)dd=Math.max(dd,100*(1-x[1]/peak));}
  const win=trades.filter(t=>t.net>0).length;
  return {curve,trades,final,returnPct:(final/1000-1)*100,drawdown:dd,winRate:trades.length?100*win/trades.length:0,stops,tps,flips,open:!!side,bankrupt};
 }
};
function msg(v,bad=false){const n=$('q36Status');if(n){n.textContent=v;n.classList.toggle('bad',!!bad);}}
function syncDatasets(){
 const sel=$('q36Dataset');if(!sel)return;
 const d=window.QUANT_DATA_PIPELINE?.list()||[],prev=sel.value;
 sel.innerHTML=d.length?d.map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x.id)}">${esc(x.symbol)} · ${esc(x.firstDate)} – ${esc(x.lastDate)}</option>`).join(''):'<option value="">Keine Daten importiert</option>';
 if(d.some(x=>x.id===prev))sel.value=prev;
 const bots=Array.from(curvePinned).filter(i=>META[i]&&state.filtered.includes(i));
 const choice=bots.length?bots:state.selected>=0&&META[state.selected]?[state.selected]:[];
 $('q36BotInfo').textContent=choice.length?`${choice.length} markiert · ${choice.slice(0,5).map(i=>META[i].id).join(', ')}${choice.length>5?' …':''}`:'Noch kein Bot markiert. Wähle einen Bot im 3D-Chart.';
}
function dateInit(){
 const dates=typeof DATES!=='undefined'?DATES:[];
 const d=dates[Math.min(state.day,dates.length-1)]||state.dataset+'-12-31';
 if(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d))$('q36End').value=d;
 else $('q36End').value=state.dataset+'-12-31';
}
function open(){
 const m=$('q36Dialog');m.hidden=false;document.body.classList.add('q36-open');
 dateInit();syncDatasets();$('q36Close').focus();
 msg('Wähle einen lokalen Datensatz und starte den Intraday-Vergleich.');
}
function close(){cancel=true;$('q36Dialog').hidden=true;document.body.classList.remove('q36-open');}
function picked(){
 let ids=Array.from(curvePinned).filter(i=>META[i]&&state.filtered.includes(i));
 if(!ids.length&&state.selected>=0&&META[state.selected])ids=[state.selected];
 return ids;
}
async function run(){
 if(busy)return;
 const dataset=$('q36Dataset').value,ids=picked();
 if(!dataset){msg('Bitte zuerst SOL/BTC-Minuten in der Datenpipeline importieren.',true);return;}
 if(!ids.length){msg('Bitte mindestens einen Bot in der 3D-Ansicht markieren.',true);return;}
 if(ids.length>12){msg('Maximal zwölf Bots pro Intraday-Analyse markieren (Speicherschutz).',true);return;}
 const endDate=$('q36End').value,days=+$('q36Days').value;
 const endTs=Date.parse(endDate+'T00:00:00Z')/1000+86400,firstTs=endTs-days*86400;
 if(!Number.isFinite(endTs)){msg('Bitte ein gültiges Enddatum wählen.',true);return;}
 const ds=await window.QUANT_DATA_PIPELINE?.getManifest(dataset);
 if(!ds){msg('Datensatz nicht verfügbar.',true);return;}
 if(firstTs<Date.parse(ds.firstDate+'T00:00:00Z')/1000 || endTs>Date.parse(ds.lastDate+'T00:00:00Z')/1000+86400){msg('Gewählter Zeitraum liegt außerhalb der Importdaten.',true);return;}
 const stop=+$('q36Stop').value,trail=+$('q36Trail').value,trailActivate=+$('q36Activation').value;
 const leverage=+$('q36Lev').value,alloc=+$('q36Alloc').value,fee=+$('q36Fee').value,slip=+$('q36Slip').value;
 const source=$('q36Source').value,mode=$('q36Take').value;
 busy=true;cancel=false;$('q36Run').disabled=true;$('q36Results').hidden=true;
 try{
  // Warmup only; does not establish a global historical Renko anchor. Document this.
  const warmup=Math.max(45,Math.min(120,Math.max(...ids.map(i=>META[i].s))*2));
  const bars=await U.loadData(dataset,firstTs-warmup*86400,endTs);
  const configs=[];
  for(let j=0;j<ids.length;j++){
   if(cancel)throw Error('Abgebrochen.');
   const bot=META[ids[j]];
   msg(`Berechne IMBA-Signale ${j+1}/${ids.length}: ${bot.id} …`);
   await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));
   const sig=U.signalMap(bars,bot,source);
   const take=mode==='gene'?(bot.tp?bot.tpValue:0):mode==='off'?0:Number(mode);
   const opt={botName:bot.id,leverage,alloc,fee,slip,trailActivate,chartStepMinutes:15,take};
   const geneTrail=mode==='gene'&&bot.ttp?bot.trail:0;
   const geneActivation=mode==='gene'&&bot.ttp?bot.act:trailActivate;
   // Existing gene TTP applies in both arms; user-added price stops are the experiment.
   const base=U.simulate(bars,sig.signals,firstTs,endTs,{...opt,trailActivate:geneActivation,stop:0,trail:geneTrail});
   const protectedRun=U.simulate(bars,sig.signals,firstTs,endTs,{...opt,trailActivate:trail?trailActivate:geneActivation,stop,trail:trail||geneTrail});
   configs.push({id:ids[j],bot,signal:sig,base,guard:protectedRun});
  }
  if(cancel)throw Error('Abgebrochen.');
  latest={dataset,ds:ds.symbol,endDate,days,source,stop,trail,trailActivate,leverage,alloc,fee,slip,mode,configs};
  results(latest);
  msg(`${configs.length} Bot(s) · ${fmt(bars.length,0)} Minuten · bestätigte Signale, Ausführung ab nächster Minute.`,false);
 }catch(e){msg(e.message,true);console.error('QUANT 0.36 Intraday',e);}
 finally{busy=false;$('q36Run').disabled=false;}
}
function results(r){
 $('q36Results').hidden=false;
 const items=r.configs,avg=key=>items.reduce((s,c)=>s+c[key].final,0)/items.length;
 const b=avg('base'),g=avg('guard');
 const st=items.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.guard.stops,0),tr=items.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.guard.trades.length,0);
 $('q36Kpis').innerHTML=[['Ohne zusätzlichen Stopp',money(b),pct((b/1000-1)*100)],['Mit Intraday-Schutz',money(g),pct((g/1000-1)*100)],['Kapitaldifferenz',money(g-b),pct((g-b)/1000*100)],['Stops / geschlossene Trades',String(st)+' / '+String(tr),'Kursbasierte Ausführung']].map(([a,b,c])=>`<div><small>${esc(a)}</small><strong>${esc(b)}</strong><span>${esc(c)}</span></div>`).join('');
 // Configs share the same sampled timestamp grid. Each trade uses 1,000€ reference;
 // the displayed mean is an equal-weight comparison, NOT the historic shared portfolio.
 const times=items[0].base.curve.map(x=>new Date(x[0]*1000).toISOString());
 const val=key=>times.map((_,j)=>items.reduce((s,c)=>s+(c[key].curve[j]?.[1]??1000),0)/items.length);
 Plotly.react('q36Chart',[
  {x:times,y:val('base'),type:'scatter',mode:'lines',line:{color:'#7aa8c2',width:2},name:'Ohne zusätzlichen SL'},
  {x:times,y:val('guard'),type:'scatter',mode:'lines',line:{color:'#71ddbf',width:3},name:'Mit Intraday-Schutz'}
 ],{paper_bgcolor:'transparent',plot_bgcolor:'transparent',font:{color:'#a5bfd1',size:11},xaxis:{gridcolor:'#203b50'},yaxis:{gridcolor:'#203b50',title:'€ je 1.000 € Startkapital'},margin:{l:62,r:18,t:18,b:45},legend:{orientation:'h',y:1.14,x:0},hovermode:'x unified'},{responsive:true,displaylogo:false});
 $('q36Table').innerHTML='<table><thead><tr><th>Bot</th><th>Quelle</th><th>IMBA</th><th>Bricks</th><th>Trades</th><th>Stopps</th><th>Ohne SL</th><th>Mit Schutz</th><th>Max. DD</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+items.map(c=>`<tr><td>${esc(c.bot.id)}</td><td>${esc(c.bot.priceMode==='renko_pct'?'%-Renko':c.bot.priceMode==='candle'?'5m Candle':'USD-Renko')} ${esc(c.bot.priceMode==='candle'?'':c.bot.b)}</td><td>${c.signal.signalCount}</td><td>${c.signal.bricks}</td><td>${c.guard.trades.length}</td><td>${c.guard.stops}</td><td>${pct(c.base.returnPct)}</td><td class="${c.guard.returnPct>=0?'q36-good':'q36-bad'}">${pct(c.guard.returnPct)}</td><td>${fmt(c.guard.drawdown,1)} %</td></tr>`).join('')+'</tbody></table>';
 const events=items.flatMap(c=>c.guard.trades).sort((a,b)=>b.exitTime-a.exitTime).slice(0,22);
 $('q36Trades').innerHTML='<table><thead><tr><th>Schlusszeit UTC</th><th>Bot</th><th>Richtung</th><th>Grund</th><th>Netto €</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+events.map(t=>`<tr><td>${iso(t.exitTime)}</td><td>${esc(t.bot)}</td><td>${t.side}</td><td>${esc(t.reason)}</td><td class="${t.net>=0?'q36-good':'q36-bad'}">${money(t.net)}</td></tr>`).join('')+'</tbody></table>';
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>Plotly.Plots.resize($('q36Chart')).catch(()=>{}));
}
function exportFile(){if(!latest)return;
 const meta=latest,lines=['bot,entry_utc,exit_utc,side,entry_price,exit_price,pnl_eur,reason'];
 const csv=v=>'"'+String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';
 for(const c of meta.configs)for(const t of c.guard.trades)lines.push([c.bot.id,iso(t.entryTime),iso(t.exitTime),t.side,t.entryPrice.toFixed(7),t.exitPrice.toFixed(7),t.net.toFixed(4),t.reason].map(csv).join(','));
 const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([lines.join('\n')],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=`QUANT_0.36_intraday_${meta.ds}_${meta.endDate}.csv`;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),3000);
}
function init(){
 if($('q36Open'))return;
 const renko=$('quantRenkoDeck');if(!renko)return;
 document.title='QUANT · Genome Research 0.36'; const ver=document.querySelector('header h1 span');if(ver)ver.textContent='0.36 · Intraday';
